rec-000418.en:
Colonel Maistroff, executive officer.
Major Focker is at the ceremony, so
you get me instead.
rec-000418.note: Maistroff introduces himself; dry. 'you get me instead' carries the source's faint irony.

rec-00047c.en: Ceremony or not, a situation has arisen.

rec-0004b0.en:
Minutes ago ARMD-1 logged a gravity
anomaly and a flash in lunar orbit.

rec-000500.en:
The same phenomenon as ten years ago, when
the SDF-1 Macross folded in near Earth.

rec-00055c.en:
Something has almost certainly folded out
there as well.

rec-0005a0.en:
And the defold reading is reported far
larger than the last one. Not comparable.

rec-0005fc.en:
Captain Global has left the ceremony for
the Macross bridge to assess the situation.

rec-000658.en:
You will fly a standing patrol over South
Ataria Island in case the worst happens.

rec-0006b0.en:
Hold your sectors. Whatever happens,
keep the damage off the ground.

rec-000700.en:
Sixty thousand civilians are on that island,
and press from all over the world.

rec-000760.en: They are not to be put at risk.

rec-0007a8.en:
Emergency! Macross main system runaway!
The main gun fired on its own!

rec-000810.en:
Update! The beam struck a probable
spacecraft at 280,000 km, inside lunar
orbit. Destroyed.

rec-00090c.en: You heard it. All craft, prepare to launch!

rec-000940.en:
The bridge will pass on changes and new
orders as they come.

rec-000988.en: The Macross is in your hands.

rec-000a04.en: We're in orbit at 120 km altitude.

rec-000a30.en:
We're making for the rendezvous point to
dock with ARMD-1 and ARMD-2.

rec-000a8c.en:
Meanwhile the hostiles from lunar orbit
are closing on us. Expect an attack.

rec-000ae4.en:
You'll screen the ship and keep the
docking safe while it happens.

rec-000b30.en: Keep those battle pods off the Macross.

rec-000b60.en:
Nobody's confirmed how those pods handle
in vacuum. Watch yourselves out there!

rec-000c04.en:
We are in main-gun configuration, hiding
in Saturn's opaque A ring.

rec-000c60.en:
Using that cover, we will mount a surprise
attack on the enemy ships with the main gun.

rec-000cc0.en:
All Valkyries: after launch, reach point
R-18 in Cassini space within three
minutes and hold.

rec-000d24.en:
This is an ambush. You must not be seen
on the way in.

rec-000d64.en:
So: no weapons in transit, and do not
leave the ring.

rec-000db4.en:
The ring is full of drifting ice. Take
great care not to strike any of it.

rec-000e0c.en:
Visibility will be poor. No lights --
fly on instruments.

rec-000e5c.en:
The object is to draw the enemy ships onto
the Macross's line of fire.

rec-000ea8.en:
When the firing countdown starts, break
away at full speed. Avoid the beam and the
blast.

rec-000f08.en: Do not dawdle in the line of fire.

rec-000f88.en:
At 1100 today we land east of Sara Base,
the U.N. Spacy Mars survey post.

rec-000fd8.en:
After landing, work parties will bring
the base's stores aboard.

rec-001020.en:
Valkyrie squadrons will guard the work
parties and the Macross against attack.

rec-001078.en: The Destroids will hold the supply route.

rec-0010ac.en:
Purple Squadron: watch station to
starboard, first defence line.

rec-0010f8.en:
Sara Base closed four years ago. The crew
died going home, to Anti-U.N. raiders.

rec-001150.en:
But we have just received an automatic
telemetry signal that appears to come from
Sara Base.

rec-0011b4.en:
It has not been heard once since the base
was closed.

rec-0011f8.en:
Something may be wrong down there.
All hands, take every care.

rec-001290.en:
Enemy fire has shattered the asteroid
Camille. The pieces are drifting all
around us.

rec-0012ec.en:
The same attack damaged the Macross's
wide-area radar. It is offline.

rec-001374.en:
Until then we are blind to everything
around us.

rec-0013c0.en:
In that state we received a transmission
apparently from the enemy. It demands our
surrender.

rec-001424.en: Captain Global has decided to ignore it.

rec-001464.en: The enemy will certainly make a new move.

rec-0014a0.en:
Lt. Hayase's Cat's Eye and Vermilion are
out searching, but the debris is slowing
them.
rec-0014a0.note: Hayase is a First Lieutenant at this date; she is promoted to Captain before row 73.

rec-001504.en:
So Cat's Eye 2 will launch to speed the
search.

rec-001594.en:
The search operator this time is Lt. Emma
Granger. She asked for the assignment
herself.
rec-001594.note: Emma Granger volunteering is the setup for the whole Cat's Eye mission.

rec-0015f8.en:
The enemy may already be moving.
Take every care.

rec-00163c.en:
A Cat's Eye is out searching, but the
debris is too thick. Slow going.

rec-0016d4.en: The Macross is outside lunar orbit.

rec-001704.en:
Earth is close, but we are completely
surrounded.

rec-00174c.en:
The cordon is battleships and medium
ships, holding range and matching course.

rec-0017ac.en:
But the intelligence Captain Hayase brought
back must reach Earth, whatever it costs.

rec-001810.en:
The object is to force the cordon and
return to Earth.

rec-001858.en:
All Valkyries: hold the enemy off to clear
the Macross's descent route to Earth.

rec-0018b8.en:
Once the descent begins, keep pressing the
enemy ships to stop pursuit.

rec-001908.en:
Once you have the range, break off and
descend on your own.

rec-001950.en:
Purple Squadron launches first and stands
watch astern of the Macross.

rec-0019a0.en:
By Capt. Hayase's analysis, they are not
trying to destroy us --

rec-0019ec.en:
-- they are working to collect information
on us.

rec-001a30.en:
Even so, they will not simply stand aside.
Go in ready for anything.

rec-001ac0.en:
I am Exsedol, Zem class one recording
officer of the Zentradi.
rec-001ac0.note: Exsedol: Zentradi register -- no contractions anywhere in this speaker.

rec-001b08.en:
The Bodol Grand Fleet comes to this system
to erase Earth and our Britai Adoclas
fleet alike.

rec-001b6c.en:
The Grand Fleet has 4,791,122 warships.
We have barely a thousand.

rec-001bbc.en: By simple arithmetic, we face 3,500 to 1.

rec-001bf4.en:
Some may call that madness. They would be
wrong.

rec-001c58.en:
You fought a foe a thousandfold your
strength -- us -- and you live.

rec-001ca4.en: Victory is not certain. A way is.

rec-001ccc.en:
Strike the Bernal class: branch-fleet
flagships of the Grand Fleet's top three
ranks.
rec-001ccc.note: Bernal class: Zentradi branch-fleet flagship class. Locked in glossary.

rec-001d28.en:
A branch fleet that loses its flagship will
often withdraw automatically, by order.

rec-001d88.en:
Further, only the Bernal-class flagships
are told the positions of the other grand
fleets.

rec-001de8.en:
Break them, and the branch fleets withdraw,
and word does not reach the other grand
fleets.

rec-001e4c.en:
To borrow Colonel Maistroff's phrase:
crush the serpent's head.

rec-001e98.en:
Escort fleets will bar the way. The target
remains the Bodol flagship.

rec-001ef0.en:
The Valkyrie squadrons must break those
escorts and open the road.

rec-001f3c.en:
The reaction warheads we held back will
be used now.

rec-001f78.en:
All units: change over to reaction
warheads. Quickly and exactly.

rec-001fc0.en:
Reaction rounds are far beyond any
conventional weapon in power and reach.

rec-002010.en:
Used near yourself, your wingmen or a
friendly ship, they will kill our own.
Take care.

rec-002070.en:
Intelligence says the Grand Fleet could
fold out at any moment.

rec-0020cc.en:
Purple Squadron: once rearmed, take up
patrol at once.

rec-002130.note: Focker's briefings use the plain form where the others use polite; 'Listen up' carries it.

rec-002164.en:
All right, rookies. Welcome to the
Prometheus.

rec-00219c.en:
Well? Big, isn't she? This is the
CVS-101 Prometheus.

rec-0021e0.en:
Built on the same tech as the Macross.
A semi-submersible carrier, 512 m long.

rec-00223c.en:
Over half again the size of the old US
Navy's Enterprise, CVN-65.

rec-002290.en: Now. Your first assignment. Listen up.

rec-0022d0.en:
You will ferry VF-1A Valkyries -- and
their new pilots.

rec-002324.en:
Destination: South Ataria Island. Yes --
where they commission the Macross today.

rec-002380.en:
Take your assigned Valkyrie, launch in
order, form up over the ship and make for
the point.

rec-0023e4.en:
In the air you follow your leader and the
controller. No freelancing. Clear?

rec-002438.en:
At the far end, land on ARMD-1, moored to
the Macross, and hand the craft to the
chief.

rec-002498.en:
To land, go to GERWALK and hover under
the hook arm for a few seconds.

rec-0024f4.en:
Do that much and the arm handles the rest
by itself.

rec-00255c.note: He is repeating the rookies' own question back at them. The joke lands in row 120.

rec-002584.en:
Use your heads. The VF-1A is a single
seater. The new pilots are you.

rec-0025e4.en:
Once you're down on ARMD-1, hand over the
craft and yourselves.

rec-002630.en:
You're posted to ARMD-1's Valkyrie corps.
Congratulations!

rec-0026dc.en:
The Macross is moving along the B ring's
outer edge.

rec-00271c.en:
Behind Saturn, and the far side of the
rings, are blind to wide-area radar.

rec-0027d4.en:
and Major Focker's flight vanished in the
rings after a fight.

rec-00281c.en:
Taken together, the enemy is certainly
hiding in this volume.

rec-002870.en:
So we will sweep the area with the Elint
Seeker to fix their position.

rec-0028d0.en:
The Elint's own pilot was wounded last
action and is in sickbay,

rec-002918.en:
and since combat is possible on this
sortie, you were chosen to fly it,
Lieutenant.
rec-002918.note: Player rank at this point is Second Lieutenant; spoken address is 'Lieutenant'.

rec-00297c.en:
Sorry to pull you off watch.
We're counting on you.

rec-0029b8.en:
Run ahead of the Macross, scout the set
volume, fix the enemy.

rec-002a04.en:
The B ring above us passes almost no
electromagnetic radiation.

rec-002a50.en:
So we expect the enemy above the rings,
behind Saturn itself, or inside the rings.

rec-002ab0.en:
If they are in any of those places, they
cannot fix our position either.

rec-002b10.en:
So do not rise above the rings. Stay
inside them and scout from cover.

rec-002b64.en:
The Elint Seeker's sensors can pick them
up through the ring material.

rec-002bbc.en:
The Elint Seeker normally carries no gun,
but as you may be engaged we fitted a
gunpod.

rec-002c20.en:
It is a field fix, so you cannot use it
in Fighter mode. Bear that in mind.

rec-002c78.en:
If you meet enemy scouts or recon craft,
kill them fast and stop word reaching
their fleet.

rec-002cdc.en:
Against a flight with no recon craft you
can likely strike first, closing from a
blind angle.

rec-002d40.en:
Normal missiles only, and few of them.
Watch your count. No long-range radar
either.

rec-002da4.en:
I'll be in the back seat as your radar
operator.

rec-002de0.en:
I trust your flying, Lieutenant -- but
drive carefully, please.

rec-002e60.en: The Macross is inside Jupiter's orbit.

rec-002e98.en:
Elint Seeker 01 called in from patrol a
short while ago.

rec-002ee8.en:
220 km ahead, what looks like an alien
battlefield --

rec-002f2c.en:
-- and a large enemy ship, crippled in
the fighting and abandoned.

rec-002fb0.en:
By its shape, it belongs to the aliens we
are fighting.

rec-002ff4.en: But we did not do that damage to it.

rec-003078.en:
Since when, against whom, and for what?
We have nothing at all on that.

rec-0030d0.en: Apollo Squadron will survey that ship.

rec-003100.en: Apollo Leader goes inside, in armour.

rec-003138.en:
Concentrate on the central computer and
gather what you can.

rec-00317c.en:
The bridge computer has already predicted
where the core should be.

rec-0031c8.en:
Apollo 2 watches the entry point.
Apollo 3 observes from outside, in case.

rec-003220.en:
The other squadrons seal the area and
escort the Macross.

rec-003268.en:
That ship appears to have been dead in
space for a considerable time.

rec-0032c0.en:
Even so, there may be automatic defences
or survivors aboard. Take every care.

rec-003318.en:
Mission start, 0900. Begin preparations
now. That is all.

rec-0033bc.en:
The Macross is down as planned, east of
the U.N. Spacy survey post, Sara Base.

rec-003410.en: Loading from Sara Base begins at 1230.

rec-003450.en:
Valkyrie squadrons will stand watch and
escort against attack.

rec-00349c.en:
No enemy is in sight, but most of the
loading party are civilian volunteers.

rec-0034f8.en:
Their safety comes first, so alert level
is above normal.

rec-003578.en:
Apollo Squadron will fit the GBP-1S
Protector Weapon System,

rec-0035c0.en: and stand watch inside the base.

rec-0035ec.en:
She lifts as soon as loading ends and
all units are aboard.

rec-003670.en:
We're this close to Earth now.
Do this properly, please.

rec-0036b4.en: Welcome to U.N. Forces flight school.

rec-0036e0.en:
Here you will learn to fly the U.N.
Forces' new fighter, the VF-1 Valkyrie,
using a trainer.

rec-003744.en:
It is built on ASS-1 overtechnology, and
it performs like nothing before it.

rec-00379c.en: Chiefly, it transforms into three modes.

rec-0037f4.en:
It handles like any other fighter, so fly
it as you would one.

rec-00384c.en: It moves fast in air and in space alike.

rec-003888.en: The other main mode is Battroid.

rec-003908.en:
In GERWALK you can hover like a VTOL and
run fast along the ground.

rec-00395c.en:
In training you will learn to fly and to
fight in each of them.

rec-0039b0.en:
You will fly the VF-1D.
Follow my directions as we go.

rec-003acc.en: You will also pass into Saturn's shadow.

rec-003b04.en:
You fly the VT-1 and VF-1D.
I'm in the 1D's back seat.
rec-003b04.note: Focker in the trainer's back seat -- the only time he says 'I' about a cockpit.

rec-003b7c.en: The Macross is outside lunar orbit.

rec-003bac.en: Earth is close, but we are surrounded.

rec-003bec.en:
But the intelligence Captain Hayase brought
back must reach Earth, whatever it costs.

rec-003c50.en:
The object is to force the cordon and
return to Earth.

rec-003c98.en: First, the diversion holds the enemy,

rec-003cc4.en:
while the Macross breaks the line ahead,
runs straight through and descends.

rec-003d1c.en:
Diversion craft board the enemy ships
around us.

rec-003d5c.en: They must be disabled from inside.

rec-003d98.en: It is very dangerous. Take care.

rec-003dcc.en:
By Capt. Hayase's analysis, they are not
trying to destroy us --

rec-003e18.en:
-- they are working to collect information
on us.

rec-003e5c.en:
Even so, they will not simply stand aside.
Go in ready for anything.

rec-003efc.note: Same string as 211/212 but Focker's plain form; kept distinct on purpose.

rec-0056e4.en:
Altitude too low.
Hold combat altitude.

rec-005718.en:
Watch your altitude!
Civilians below you.

rec-00576c.en:
Altitude too high.
Hold combat altitude.

rec-005964.en: So you made it up, rookie.

rec-0059b4.en:
Kill their air units.
Don't get cocky.

rec-005a10.en:
First sortie, first kill!
Maybe you've got something.
rec-005a10.note: Source prefixes this and rows 234-248 with a developer 'cut' marker; the marker is dropped from the English. See Q-04.

rec-005a70.en:
Bruce! Don't tell me aliens
have got you spooked?

rec-005ab4.en:
Don't lump me in with you.
Got time to worry about me?

rec-005af4.en:
Don't underestimate Eddie.
Just watch me!
rec-005af4.note: Eddie's one third-person self-reference (quirk register: once only).

rec-005b60.en:
Yeah. She's huge.
No aliens are taking her.

rec-005ba4.en:
Damn it, why today of
all days...

rec-005bd4.en:
No kidding. At this rate
she's sunk before she flies.

rec-005c74.en: All right, we can do this!

rec-005d28.en:
Many enemy ground units.
Battroid mode; wipe them
out.

rec-005d98.en:
Mind your altitude -- stay
on the ground targets!

rec-005dd4.en:
Altitude too high.
Ground targets first.

rec-005e58.en:
Skull 7's sector is the
city! Do not leave your
post!

rec-005e9c.en:
Do not leave the combat
area!

rec-005ec4.en:
Please stay in the combat
area!

rec-005f18.en:
You'll wreck the city --
no missiles!

rec-005f84.en:
I told you again and again:
no missiles. You are off the
mission. Return to base.

rec-005fe4.en:
Missiles wreck the city. If
you will not obey orders,
you are off this mission.
Return.

rec-006048.en:
The missile ban protects
civilians. You are off the
mission. Return at once.

rec-00609c.en:
Damage to buildings and
civilians must be kept to a
minimum. Take great care
with missiles.

rec-006100.en:
Gunsight 1. The ship is
lifting off now.

rec-00622c.en:
Gunsight 1. Lifting off
again on conventional
engines.

rec-006290.en:
Earth-built engines this
time. They'd better fly.

rec-0062cc.en:
Gunsight 1. The ship is
climbing to satellite orbit.
All Valkyries, join her
above.

rec-006348.en:
Stop hitting buildings!
You make it worse.

rec-00637c.en:
Stop wrecking the city!
Once more and you're off.

rec-0063b8.en:
You will not listen. You
are off the mission.
Return to the ship now!

rec-006404.en:
Enemy commander down.
Ground units withdraw.

rec-006458.en:
Go high and you become a
target. Be careful!

rec-006494.en:
Climb and they'll pick you
off. Careful!

rec-0064c8.en:
Damage to the city must be
kept to a minimum.

rec-006500.en:
When you use missiles, take
care not to destroy any
buildings.

rec-00656c.en:
It's alien salvage. We
can't complain.

rec-0065f8.en:
Gunsight 1. Lifting off
again, on Earth-built
engines.

rec-006654.en:
Enemy commander down.
Ground units withdraw.

rec-006688.en:
Your job is escort! Stay
with the Macross! Go any
further and you are off
this mission!

rec-0066e8.en:
Too far from the Macross.
Keep escort distance.

rec-00672c.en:
Skull 7, you are too far
from the Macross! Come
back now!

rec-006774.en:
You may not leave the
Macross. You are off the
mission -- return at once!

rec-0067c8.en:
That far out you cannot
escort anyone. Off the
mission. Return now!

rec-006818.en:
If you cannot hold your
assigned area, I cannot
leave this to you. Return
to base.

rec-0068c0.en:
Friendlies engaged with an
enemy fleet at the
rendezvous point!

rec-006908.en:
ARMD-1, Miranda and Akishima
appear to be destroyed!

rec-00695c.en:
Skull Leader to all
Valkyries! Nobody touches
the Macross! Put your backs
into it!

rec-006a1c.en:
The ship will descend,
make for South Ataria
Island and fold near the
surface.

rec-006a78.en:
All Valkyries, cover her
and descend with her.

rec-006ab0.en:
Madness! An untested
space fold -- and near the
surface at that...

rec-006b24.en:
Stow the chatter and
guard the Macross!

rec-006b5c.en:
She's helpless in re-entry.
Kill everything around her
before it starts!

rec-006bb0.en:
Entry in 120 seconds.
We cannot wait longer.

rec-006c38.en:
Enemy still present. We
cannot begin re-entry!
We can't hold!

rec-006cc8.en:
If only the fold goes as
well...

rec-006d68.en:
Altitude too high. Return
to your sector.

rec-006da0.en:
Altitude too low. Return
to your sector.

rec-006dd4.en:
We are under fire from
satellite orbit!

rec-006e08.en:
To throw the enemy off,
the ship will descend to
South Ataria Island and
fold near the surface.

rec-006e70.en:
The ship keeps descending
and will fold on reaching
the set altitude.

rec-006ebc.en:
Valkyries, intercept the
pursuit and return before
then.

rec-006f00.en:
Enemy reinforcements. No
time left -- Valkyries,
return now.

rec-006f48.en:
Fold in 60 seconds.
Valkyries, return to the
ship at once!

rec-006f94.en:
No time left! The ship
folds immediately!

rec-006fd8.en:
Pursuers still out there!
Drive them off!

rec-007010.en:
High energy in satellite
orbit! Closing fast!

rec-007044.en:
Land on the deck in
Battroid or GERWALK.

rec-007084.en:
Fold is imminent! Get back
to the Macross, quickly!

rec-0070ec.en:
Get back to escort range
of the Macross.

rec-007120.en:
Too far from the Macross!
Come back!

rec-007154.en:
Enemy strike closing!
Scramble, all Valkyries.
Repeat, scramble all craft!

rec-0071a8.en:
The Macross is under heavy
fleet attack.

rec-0071dc.en:
All Valkyries, destroy the
battle pods around the
Macross!

rec-007224.en:
You heard her! Scatter
those things off the
Macross!

rec-007290.en:
No.2 and 5 turrets hit!
Cannot repair.

rec-007310.en:
Damn it... they're going to
kill her!

rec-007360.en:
We hit what's in front of
us. Don't rush and foul
it up!

rec-0073a8.en:
All hands. The ship goes
to main gun configuration.

rec-007410.en:
Transformation? What the
hell is that?
rec-007410.note: Focker asks what Transformation means -- the capital T distinction is load-bearing here.

rec-007440.en:
To restore power to the
main gun, the whole ship
must transform.

rec-007490.en:
Serious damage to the
civilian districts is
expected!

rec-0074fc.en:
hold the Macross together
somehow until
Transformation!

rec-007540.en:
Rookies! You heard it!
They're paying in civilian
lives. Do not fail!

rec-007594.en:
Pick off the ones clinging
to the hull with gunpod --
carefully!

rec-0075dc.en:
Missiles will damage the
Macross too. Careful!

rec-00761c.en:
Who was that! No use for
anyone who won't take my
orders! Again and you're
off.

rec-007674.en:
I told you! No use for
anyone who won't obey.
Get back here, now!

rec-0077a4.en:
Well done. You've improved,
7. Skull Leader to Gunsight
1 -- we held, just about!

rec-007808.en:
Transformation starting!
Escorts, open your
distance!

rec-00784c.en:
Get back in the combat
area!

rec-007870.en:
You are too far from the
Macross. Get back now.

rec-0078a8.en:
Transformation in progress.
It's dangerous -- keep
away!

rec-0078e8.en:
Gunsight 1. The ship fires
her main gun the moment
Transformation completes!

rec-00793c.en:
Valkyries, keep clearing
the enemy around her.

rec-007990.en:
A robot? That's the shape
that fires the gun?!

rec-0079d8.note: House form 'Macross damage NN%' -- rows 515/517/519 have an 18-byte slot that will not take a colon, so the colon is dropped everywhere for consistency.

rec-007b58.en:
Macross at her limit!
No more, we can't...

rec-007c4c.en:
The Macross is under fire!
Valkyries, intercept!

rec-007c90.en:
Take care firing missiles
or you will damage the
Macross too! Be careful!

rec-007ce4.en:
What are you doing?! The
enemy will spot us! Get
back now!

rec-007d28.en:
What were you listening to
at the briefing? Get back
now.

rec-007d6c.en:
Stay in the set area.
They will spot us.

rec-007da8.en:
If they see you the whole
unit is in danger. Off the
mission -- return at once!

rec-007e04.en:
If you won't follow
orders, you're off.
Return to base.

rec-007e44.en:
You must not leave the
area! If you can't do it,
return to the Macross.

rec-007e94.en:
No weapons inside the
ring. They'll spot us!

rec-007ed0.en:
Orange, Purple and Rose:
pass through the ring ahead
and move to point R-18 in
Cassini space.

rec-007f38.en:
Draw them into the
gun line.

rec-007f5c.en:
All right. Don't touch
the ice. Take it steady.

rec-007f94.en:
If they make us, we're
finished. No weapons
until I say.

rec-00801c.en:
Careful. Hit the ice and
there's no ambush at all.

rec-008058.en:
And we make the rendezvous
on time? Sure...

rec-00808c.en:
Skull Leader to all craft.
Entering the planet's
shadow. Watch the ice, and
your instruments!

rec-008104.en:
This is no time to dawdle.
You are off the mission.

rec-008144.en:
You're late! Get a grip!
Return to the Macross!

rec-008180.en:
You did not reach the set
point in time. You are off
the mission. Return.

rec-0081dc.en:
Do not leave the
operation area!

rec-008254.en:
Kill the small fry. Draw
them out!

rec-00827c.en:
All right! Out of the ring
and it's ours. Bruce,
let's go!

rec-008308.en:
Why won't the Macross
fire her main gun?!

rec-008338.en:
Trouble!
The main gun will not fire!

rec-008364.en:
Oh hell! We're dead if
this keeps up!

rec-008394.en:
All Destroids, assemble
on the Daedalus, at once.

rec-0083f4.en:
Gunsight 1 to all craft.
The ship will execute
Operation D. All Valkyries,
cover her.

rec-00848c.en:
You heard it! Purple, shoot
those missiles down! Keep
them off the Macross!

rec-008508.en:
Pin Point Barrier to the
Daedalus bow!

rec-00853c.en: What is she going to do?!

rec-008580.en:
Macross damage 10%
Purple Squadron! Stop those
missiles!

rec-0085c4.en:
Macross damage 20%
The Pin Point Barrier alone
cannot hold them!

rec-00860c.en:
Macross damage 30%
Purple! Stop those missiles!

rec-00865c.en:
This is no time to play!
Do that again and you're
out of the operation!

rec-0086ac.en:
This mission is beyond you.
Return to the Macross!

rec-0086f4.en:
Halfway point passed.
Care all the way...

rec-008724.en:
At that pace you will not
make it. Full speed!

rec-008768.en:
Nearly there. Don't ease
off now...

rec-008794.en:
Enemy course plotted.
Contact in 90 sec.

rec-00881c.en:
Off their bow. Between
their ship and ours!

rec-00889c.en:
Why won't the Macross
fire her main gun?!

rec-0088e4.en:
Purple Squadron, hold the
first defence line!

rec-008948.en:
Where do you think you're
going?! Hold your area!

rec-0089d0.en:
No idea. Radar may have
picked something up.

rec-008a08.en:
Macross lifting. Gravity
control standing by.

rec-008ad8.en:
Something deep underground!
It seems to be pinning the
gravity control system.

rec-008b2c.en:
A trap? This is bad. Just
keep them off the Macross!

rec-008b74.en:
Looks that way. We're
pinned here.

rec-008bac.en:
[They cannot fly! Kill the
small fry now!]
rec-008bac.note: Kamjin. Enemy transmissions ship in [square brackets] -- the source's own corner-bracket convention.

rec-008bf8.en:
No idea. Enemy comms,
sounds like.

rec-008c74.en:
Damn it. This is bad. Just
keep them off the Macross!

rec-008cbc.en:
Gunsight 1 to all craft.
Operation Overrun is live.

rec-008d00.en:
Sara Base reactor is
running away. Critical in
180 seconds.

rec-008d44.en:
That blast destroys the
gravity mines and the
Macross lifts.

rec-008d88.en:
Destroids and Valkyries,
fall back. Draw the enemy
near the base and hurt them
where you can.

rec-008df0.en:
All Valkyries, hold ground
inside the base to draw the
enemy in.

rec-008e38.en:
Full speed out at ten
seconds.

rec-008e84.en:
Mind your altitude.
This is a ground fight.

rec-008eb8.en:
How high are you going!
They're down here!

rec-008f08.en:
Clear the enemy inside the
base first.

rec-008f34.en:
Clear the enemy in the
base!

rec-008f90.en:
Damn! There's a limit to
baiting them! Is it
critical yet?!

rec-009088.en:
[Some of them can fight
after all.]

rec-0090b4.en:
[You lot, the rest is
yours. I need a rest.]

rec-0090e8.en:
Kill him and maybe we get
somewhere!

rec-009138.en:
All Valkyries, take up
intercept posture.

rec-00916c.en:
Enemy leader identified.
Drive off the commander and
stop their advance.

rec-0091e4.en:
Sara Base reactor running
away. Critical in 5 min.

rec-009224.en:
First defence line broken.
Macross damage 10%

rec-00925c.en:
Macross damage 20%
Keep them off her!

rec-00930c.en:
Macross damage 60%
This is getting bad!

rec-0093d4.en:
Destroids, fall back now.
Recover to the Daedalus.

rec-00940c.en:
Climb and you make
yourself a target!

rec-009440.en:
Climb and you're an easy
mark. Careful!

rec-009474.en:
Skull 23 is going in for
Lt. Hayase, who is still
inside the base.

rec-0094c0.en:
Clear the enemy inside to
cover them.

rec-0094f4.en:
Lt. Hayase is secure.
Pulling out of Sara Base.

rec-0095c4.en:
Reaching critical.
We will not make it.

rec-009618.en:
Enemy leader identified.
Destroy the commander and
stop their advance.

rec-009688.en:
Get back to escort range
of the Macross.

rec-0096bc.en:
You are too far from the
Macross. Come back now.

rec-0096f8.en:
Sorry to call you off
watch. The duty pilot is
away and could not get
here, so this is on you.

rec-009760.en:
A probable enemy scout is
circling directly above
us, 12 o'clock.

rec-0097a8.en:
Identify it at once, and
if it is hostile, destroy
it.

rec-0097e8.en:
Your craft has the GBP-1S
Protector Weapon System --
armoured fit.

rec-009834.en:
Heavy armour and a lot of
missiles, but it is
Battroid only.

rec-009880.en:
No transforming until the
mission ends.

rec-0098b0.en:
And now the second round,
judged in swimwear --
chiefly on the beauty of
the figure...

rec-009918.en:
Odd. The ship's TV is
bleeding into the military
band.

rec-009958.en:
They started broadcasting
today. The interference
filters may not be set.

rec-0099a8.en:
Do not let it distract
you. The enemy is close.

rec-009a14.en:
[Look! Males and females
on the same ship!]

rec-009aec.en:
[Blue Wind here. Scout
wrecked. Data lost...]

rec-009b2c.en:
We have our Miss Macross!
Lynn Minmay!

rec-009b64.en:
You did not clear the
enemy in time. You are off
the mission. Return.

rec-009bb4.en:
Still not clear? Pull out;
I will send someone else.

rec-009c10.en:
You did not clear the
enemy in time. You are off
the mission. Return.

rec-009c60.en:
Transform and the armour
comes off. Mind that.

rec-009d7c.en:
Mission complete. Well
done -- come home.

rec-009db4.en:
Purple Squadron, too far
from the Cat's Eye. Get
back.

rec-009df4.en:
Purple Squadron, your job
is escort. No freelancing!

rec-009e38.en:
Purple Squadron, go much
further and you will not
get back in time. Return.

rec-009f00.en:
Cat's Eye destroyed!
What were you doing?!

rec-009f38.en:
It's bad! The Cat's Eye
blew up! What do we do...?

rec-009f70.en:
Cat's Eye destroyed!
Crew status unknown!

rec-00a070.en:
Cat's Eye lost!
Gone from the radar!

rec-00a0a8.en:
Purple Squadron! Escort
was your mission!

rec-00a124.en:
This is an escort mission.
Even if you meet the enemy,
the Cat's Eye comes first.

rec-00a1a8.en:
Hear that? They call
themselves Zentradi.

rec-00a210.en:
Hey, they say Lynn Minmay
-- Miss Macross -- makes
her idol debut next Sunday.

rec-00a270.en:
Yeah. The girl in the
dress at Nyan-Nyan. Not
bad, I thought.

rec-00a2b8.en:
My. Minmay has this many
fans already?

rec-00a2f8.en:
Yes, ma'am. She's, well,
an idol born inside the
Macross.

rec-00a340.en:
That is correct, ma'am!
This man is a fan also!
rec-00a340.note: Eddie parodies formal military speech to impress Emma; the stiffness is the joke and must survive.

rec-00a378.en:
For her sake too, then, we
have to protect the
Macross.

rec-00a3c4.en:
Now -- escort my scout
properly, please.

rec-00a3f4.en:
Understood, ma'am! With
our lives, ma'am!

rec-00a42c.en:
Cat's Eye 2. Asteroid
debris ahead, cannot
evade -- destroy it!

rec-00a5c8.en:
Leave it. What escort
leaves its charge?

rec-00a5f8.en:
Cat's Eye 2 here. Never
mind me -- go deal with
them.

rec-00a638.en:
But moving with no escort
at all is too dangerous.

rec-00a674.en:
I can look after myself.
Stop dithering and go.
That is an order.
rec-00a674.note: Emma's one flat order in the whole game. Do not soften it.

rec-00a6c8.en:
An order is an order.
Captain, let's go.

rec-00a760.en:
I'm fine here. This time,
go after them!

rec-00a7b0.en:
I am a soldier too. I will
not be a weight on you.

rec-00a7f8.en:
Nothing for it. Captain,
let's go.

rec-00a890.en:
Don't make me say it
again. Go after them!

rec-00a8ec.en:
Checking odd enemy moves
is part of the job. Go!

rec-00a97c.en:
Honestly. What are they
playing at...

rec-00a9c8.en:
Something's going on.
Follow them! We won't know
unless we do.

rec-00aa40.en:
Captain, let's go. At this
rate you'll face a court
martial.

rec-00ab34.en:
That was bad. We shouldn't
have left.

rec-00ab64.en:
She gave the order plain
enough. Not the Captain's
fault.

rec-00aba4.en:
Missiles on him will hit
the Cat's Eye too. Use the
gunpod!

rec-00abec.en:
You! Making fools of us --
you are not getting away!

rec-00ac54.en:
I'm glad it was you three
on escort.

rec-00ac80.en:
Recon flight, respond.
Are you all right?

rec-00acb4.en:
Escort 2 here. That was
close -- they were going
for the Cat's Eye.

rec-00ad08.en:
So it is... Cat's Eye 1,
with Lt. Hayase aboard, is
missing along with its
escort...

rec-00add4.en:
We have the Lieutenant
back. Now finish the rest!

rec-00ae10.en:
Bad news! They've captured
the Cat's Eye!

rec-00ae40.en:
Captain! Missiles on him
will damage the Cat's Eye!

rec-00ae9c.en:
Purple Squadron, your area
is XP9866... no, sorry,
XT8796. Please don't leave
it.

rec-00aefc.en:
Purple Squadron, I think
that's outside your area.
Um... please come back.

rec-00af50.en:
Purple Squadron, Purple
Squadron -- not that way.
Please come back.

rec-00afa4.en:
Enemy units closing. All
craft, launch!

rec-00aff8.en:
Priority! Word just in
from maintenance.

rec-00b028.en:
Your fire control is not
fully tuned, 2nd
Lieutenant.

rec-00b064.en:
Your fire control is not
fully tuned, Lieutenant.

rec-00b0a0.en:
Your fire control is not
fully tuned, Captain.

rec-00b0dc.en:
Your fire control is not
fully tuned, Major.

rec-00b118.en:
Your fire control is not
fully tuned, Lt. Colonel.

rec-00b154.en:
Your fire control is not
fully tuned, Colonel.

rec-00b190.en:
Missiles are unavailable!
Take great care.

rec-00b1ec.en:
Purple! Something new is
heading your way. It's
good -- be careful!

rec-00b238.en:
[Milia to Commander
Laplamiz. Mission
complete. Returning.]

rec-00b27c.en:
Please respond. Macross
bridge, Misa Hayase, and
four others.

rec-00b2c4.en:
We took an enemy pod.
Adrift. Need help...

rec-00b2f8.en:
Hear that?! That's Lt.
Hayase -- the one who went
missing!

rec-00b338.en:
She's alive! If they took
an enemy pod, were they
prisoners?

rec-00b384.en:
Now we might learn what the
enemy are. This is big...

rec-00b3c8.en:
Purple Squadron, please --
Lt. Hayase is adrift in
your area.
rec-00b3c8.note: The junior operator's over-polite address marker; carried by a deferential 'please' at roughly the source's own rate, not on every line.

rec-00b40c.en:
Position going to your
radar. Close in and catch
her in Battroid.

rec-00b454.en:
Purple 3. I have Lt.
Hayase's pod. Returning
now.

rec-00b49c.en:
[Hm. So some Micronians
can play after all. We
finish this next time.]

rec-00b4f0.en:
[One of them may be worth
fighting...]

rec-00b544.en:
Close on the drifting pod
and catch it in Battroid.

rec-00b580.en:
We did it! When we get
back, let's celebrate!

rec-00b5e4.en:
That's Kakizaki for you.
Right, drinks are on me.

rec-00b658.en:
Yeah. Getting out at all
is something.

rec-00b688.en:
Word is she kissed Lt.
Ichijo to manage it...

rec-00b6bc.en:
Wh-- what?! My Captain...
Unforgivable. And they got
promoted together!

rec-00b70c.en:
Maybe I should get caught
by the Zentradi too. With
Minmay.

rec-00b754.en:
Th-- that would be quite a
situation...

rec-00b788.en:
Part of the fleet is
turning toward us! About
ten ships!

rec-00b7c8.en:
Gunsight 1. Purple
Squadron, you heard it --
intercept!

rec-00b808.en:
Yack, deculture. Prehortou
de kerkastou Kamjin,
dants.
rec-00b808.note: Zentradi language, left untranslated in the source; romanised, not Englished.

rec-00b8b4.en:
Captain, Captain! ...No
good. No answer. Nothing
on radar either...

rec-00b934.en:
Don't talk rot! Not the
Captain...

rec-00b960.en:
The Macross begins
Transformation in a few
minutes, and fires her
main gun 60 seconds later.

rec-00b9c8.en:
This whole area is bad!
Bruce, we're going!
Captain! If you can hear
this, get out of here now!

rec-00ba84.en:
[How is the enemy on
this ship?!]

rec-00bb10.en: No good! We won't make it!

rec-00bb4c.en:
We take the gap in their
cordon and enter Earth's
air. Valkyries, follow.

rec-00bbb4.en:
Let's go too, Captain!
Earth at last!

rec-00bbe4.en:
Purple 3! Purple Leader is
inside the enemy ship...!

rec-00bc3c.en:
No good! Without armour we
can't break this hatch.

rec-00bc80.en:
Captain! Is there another
hatch you can get out of?!

rec-00bcbc.en:
The Macross is in danger
too.

rec-00bce0.en:
The main gun cannot be
delayed. Get out somehow!

rec-00bd20.en:
Damn! This area's bad!
Bruce, we're going!

rec-00bd78.en:
Bruce! Get a grip -- there
is nothing we can do by
staying!

rec-00bdc4.en:
Captain! Get out of there,
fast!

rec-00be60.en:
There seem to be security
devices. Be careful!

rec-00bec8.en:
Macross, Transformation
complete! Main gun fires
in 60 seconds.

rec-00c038.en:
You have reached the
target ship. Begin your
entry.

rec-00c0a0.en:
You are inside. Destroy
the reactor from within to
disable the ship.

rec-00c0f4.en:
Reactor destroyed! Get out
of there, fast.

rec-00c23c.en:
Clear the enemy in the
area!

rec-00c280.en:
Enemy units closing! Major
Focker, keep them away
from the Macross.

rec-00c2e4.en:
The Macross is resupplying
and cannot move. Destroy
them.

rec-00c330.en:
Never heard of it. Some
brass-only code, maybe.

rec-00c36c.en:
Listen! Some of those fast
ones from before are in
there. Watch it!

rec-00c3bc.en:
Purple, wipe out the ones
over the Macross!

rec-00c410.en:
[Go! Now, which of them
is this great pilot...]

rec-00c448.en:
Gunsight 1. Skull Leader,
the enemy are moving oddly.
They seem to be going only
for Vermilion 3.

rec-00c4dc.en:
I don't know. It's just
how it looks from here.

rec-00c520.en:
Right, we'll soon find
out. Max, run!

rec-00c5a4.en:
Ngh--
(Fatal wound here. Focker
does not let it show; it
just bleeds into the voice.)
rec-00c5a4.note: A developer stage direction shipped inside the data, describing Focker's fatal wound. Preserved as a parenthetical, per the Brief.

rec-00c624.en:
Damn! Their commander is
inside! All craft, back
to the Macross!

rec-00c66c.en:
Combat area updated!
Clear the enemy around
the Macross!

rec-00c6b8.en:
Damage to the Macross is
likely -- missiles are
prohibited!

str-003f24-592.note: Left untranslated: the whole string is the developers' 'cut line' marker, with no text to translate.

rec-00c7e4.en:
Vermilion 3, they've lost
the will to fight.
No pursuit.

rec-00c834.en:
[I will repay this
humiliation one day.]

rec-00c884.en:
Major Focker, your nose is
dropping. You all right?

rec-00c8c0.en:
Rare for you to take a
hit, boss.

rec-00c910.en:
Vermilion 3 here. Nicely
done, Purple Leader. I'll
leave those to you!

rec-00c984.note: Source leaves the dodging pilot's subject unstated; English keeps it unstated so the player's gender stays unmarked.

rec-00c9b4.en:
Fast. Is this the tough
one Purple Leader talked
about?!

rec-00ca00.en:
Skull Leader to Vermilion.
Listen, you lot! Your
leader is away -- all the
more reason to do it right!

rec-00caa4.en:
Purple Leader. You and
Hikaru carry this outfit
now... Counting on you...
rec-00caa4.note: Focker's last order. Anchor line for phase 3.

rec-00caf8.en:
Roger. Save me some
pineapple salad.

rec-00cb24.en:
Their commander is heading
your way. Be careful.

rec-00cb5c.en:
Purple Leader, they've
lost the will to fight.
No pursuit.

rec-00cb9c.en:
The enemy attacking the
Macross have withdrawn.
Alert status is lifted.

rec-00cbec.en:
Hold combat altitude!
If the ground takes damage
it will be terrible!

rec-00cc38.en:
Watch your altitude!
Do not go any lower!

rec-00cc6c.en:
Stay above combat altitude!
We cannot drag civilians
into this.

rec-00cd58.en:
Unknown craft in the
atmosphere, closing.
Probably an enemy strike.

rec-00cdcc.en:
[You lot -- jamming to
maximum! Make it loud!]

rec-00ce28.en:
Long-range radar out --
enemy jamming. Valkyries,
watch for reinforcement.

rec-00ce78.en:
[Butcher to Makdomilla.
How is it your end?]
rec-00ce78.note: 'Butcher' renders Kamjin's war-name, which he uses as his own callsign.

rec-00ceac.en:
[Makdomilla here. Down
near the ground, as
planned.]

rec-00cf08.en:
Purple 2 here! Big enemy
warship sighted!

rec-00cfe8.en:
Whoa. It turned all that
back.

rec-00d014.en:
Now if only they'd give
up.

rec-00d044.en:
[That sphere seems to be
stopping our fire. Orders?]

rec-00d0b8.en:
Gunsight 1. This time they
may be serious. Hit those
ships while the barrier
still holds!

rec-00d120.en:
Sink them here and the
city takes the damage.
Go for their turrets!

rec-00d174.en:
Keeps the damage off the
Macross, you mean.

rec-00d220.en:
Enemy fleet in the red
zone, still firing.

rec-00d250.en:
Barrier system fault!
All crews, evacuate!

rec-00d2a4.en:
All Valkyries! Get clear,
as far as you can! Repeat,
get clear now!

rec-00d30c.en:
The barrier will blow --
you at least, run!

rec-00d3b0.en:
No good! I'm not going to
make it-- aaagh--!

rec-00d40c.en:
She's taken too much. The
barrier will blow -- you
at least, run!

rec-00d4ac.en:
No! The Captain won't
make it!

rec-00d4ec.en:
We killed a lot of guns!
Is the Macross okay?!

rec-00d524.en:
No idea. Fewer guns, but
she's still taking a lot
of fire...

rec-00d5b8.note: 'Barrier failing!' is the locked carrier for this callout family (rows 862-866).

rec-00d610.en:
All their turrets are
destroyed. Move to the
next ship.

rec-00d69c.en:
That's outside the area.
Come back now.

rec-00d6cc.en:
Enemy spreading, closing
at 12 o'clock. Purple,
hold our port bow!

rec-00d760.en:
Destroids, stand by to run
a Daedalus Attack at any
moment.

rec-00d7b0.en:
Looks like they'll draw
them in and go for a
Daedalus Attack.

rec-00d810.en:
Odd. Usually that blows
them apart...

rec-00d890.en:
Pods boarded to starboard!
Fifty or sixty of them,
inside!

rec-00d8f4.en:
Starboard means the
Daedalus... they turned the
Daedalus Attack around and
baited a trap with it!

rec-00d95c.en:
Purple Squadron! You heard
it. Clear your area fast
and get back aboard!

rec-00d9ac.en:
The nerve of them!
Captain! Let's clear it
and get back!

rec-00da54.en:
You'll wreck the city --
no missiles!

rec-00da88.en:
I told you again and again:
no missiles. You are off the
mission. Return to base.

rec-00dae8.en:
Missiles wreck the city. If
you will not obey orders,
you are off this mission.
Return.

rec-00db4c.en:
The missile ban protects
civilians. You are off the
mission. Return at once.

rec-00dba0.en:
No missiles inside the
ship. Use the gunpod and
the head laser.

rec-00dbf8.en:
No missiles inside the
ship. Use the gunpod.

rec-00dc40.en:
~ (Minmay's song, bleeding
~ across from the ship's
~ broadcast)
rec-00dc40.note: The source plays a snatch of a Minmay song bleeding into the military band. Shipped as a diegetic marker rather than an English lyric -- the line's job is 'her song is on this channel', and the words themselves are copyrighted. See Q-11.

rec-00dccc.en:
[You lot! I will not have

engine block too.

block...

make our peace...

battle, would be best.'

not bad.

everything.

first. Prepare to fire!]

Base. Is Alaska Base still
alive?

HQ's last weapon -- the
Grand Cannon...

Macross to the Britai
Adoclas flagship
Nupetiet-Vergnitzs.
Commander Britai?

Commander, Captain Global
would speak with you.

Commander Britai, have
your fleet translate
Minmay's song live,

military band.

why?

The Bodol Grand Fleet's

Protoculture is.

Play her song and they
will take culture shock,

and their command chain
should falter, briefly.

And in the confusion,
strike Bodol's flagship.

We cannot beat him head
on.

Very well. The song will
lift my soldiers as well.

Rearming with reaction
rounds nearly done.

Purple Squadron, return
now and rearm.

rounds!

Mission failed. Come on
home.

To all hands of the
Macross and the Britai
Adoclas fleet.

We advance through the gap
the Grand Cannon opened.

Any ship or craft not
relaying Lynn Minmay's
song is an enemy.

across every band we use.]

to me!

Pin Point Barrier to the
bow.

Surviving enemy ships are
folding out.

Very well. We return to
Earth.

rounds in this area.

Five enemy ships in our
path!

mission as equipped.

bulkhead and open a way in

High energy over Earth's
north pole!

round. Use it well.

area!

your ARMD-1 posting is
cancelled!

me.

craft in satellite orbit,

Ataria Island!

The Macross is at
Condition One and taking
civilians aboard.

Welcome party's postponed.
Maximum combat speed!

We reach the point over
South Ataria in three
minutes! Anyone late is
discharged!

Update! Alien craft are
attacking the Macross!

Some of them have turned
toward you! Look out!

Intercept and press on
to South Ataria!

Kill them cleanly as you
go!

like we made it.

Delta 1 to all. Enemy
ground units in the city!

Go Battroid and wipe out
the ground units.

Until the civilians are
clear, take care not to
destroy buildings when you
use missiles.

Until the civilians are
clear, missiles are
prohibited. Gunpod only.

Mind your altitude -- stay
on the ground targets!

Hurry and clear the
ground units!

civilians aboard.

aboard. Hold the enemy off
until then.

The Macross will make an

barely been tested!

me!

him.

units first.

until they are aboard.

every unit around her.

Ataria Island. Probably
enemy fire from orbit.

your radar.

Evasion before anything
else.

orbit is concentrating on
the Prometheus! She looks
hit!

ready any time!

her main gun the moment
Transformation completes!

clearing the enemy around
her.

don't slip up!

there too. Nasty. Those
things are quick...

Pull yourself together.

stay on what's in front
of us!

To fire the main gun, the
power must be connected --
so the whole ship changes
shape.

What kind of build is
that?

There are civilians on
that ship! She does not go
down! Do not let this fail!

rec-010db8.en:
Right, that's time!
Skull 7, 11 -- well done!

So that's Transformation!

Here they come!
Kakizaki has the target!

Return inside it at once.

the area!

Hold formation!

a hole in the barrage!

intercept formation 17.

Hold formation and press
in. Fire the moment you
lock. Clear?

speed and go to intercept!

2nd Defence, and clear
them out fast.

the head laser.

ship! Pull yourself
together!

ship.

Clear the housing blocks
fast, then go deeper.

done -- come home.

Enemy still in Housing 1!
Protect the civilians!

block. Enemy, probably.

the rest in one go!

rest in one go!

Clear the housing blocks
fast, then go deeper.

Major Focker's orders,

missiles.

die.

can do.

carrying ECM.

fix their ship's position.

five minutes.

hold...?

radar!

Major Focker.

Earth soon...

stations!

the base and hold.

loading.

finished!

let them get a shot.

your sector!

all female.

somehow!

this moment.

lost.

Golg Bodolza and take back
our culture!

hope.

area.

back safe. Please...

rec-0147f8.en:
That girl, the last hope
of the human race...

rec-014850.en:
The ship is advancing on
the fortress's centre.

rec-014890.en:
All Valkyries, clear every
force on her line of
advance.

rec-0148e0.en:
Apollo Squadron, destroy
the fortress AA guns
aiming at her!

rec-014928.en:
Keep her damage to a
minimum.

rec-014960.en:
The ship is advancing on
the fortress's centre.

rec-0149a0.en:
Apollo Squadron, clear
every force on her line
of advance.

rec-0149e8.en:
Apollo Squadron, destroy
the fortress AA guns
aiming at her,

rec-014a30.en:
and keep her damage to a
minimum.

rec-014a98.en:
Apollo Leader has Bodolza
in sight!

rec-014b24.en:
Apollo Leader has reached
the fortress centre!

rec-014b58.en:
Apollo Leader has reached
the fortress centre!

rec-014bc4.en:
Apollo Leader, at the
fortress core, destroy the
command unit Golg Bodolza.

rec-014c18.en:
Golg Bodolza is a living
command computer, the core
of this fortress.

rec-014c6c.en:
Destroy him and the fold
system will run away and
tear the whole fortress
apart.

rec-014d00.note: Emma's phase-3 line: the title is gone and she does not finish the thought. Do not tidy this.

rec-014d58.en:
Do not leave the training
area.

rec-014de0.en: This is no time to play!

rec-014e2c.en:
Don't touch that on
your own.

rec-014e54.en:
I didn't tell you to do
that!

rec-014ed0.en:
Holding back won't make
you better. Try it.

rec-014fc4.en:
This mode is for moving
fast through the air.

rec-014ff8.en:
If the enemy is a fast
flier, close on it in this
mode first.

rec-015070.en:
Target craft are flying
out there. Close in and
attack.

rec-0150b0.en:
Boost button to speed up,
brake button to slow down.

rec-0150fc.en:
When the box grows, you
are in missile range.

rec-015134.en:
Press the lock-on button
and lock the enemy up.

rec-015198.en:
Hold the lock and it
multiplies -- several
missiles fire at once.

rec-015248.en:
Range and power differ,
so pick to suit.

rec-015288.en:
If the enemy is high
ahead, pull back on the
stick to point up.

rec-0152d0.en:
Once you have it, lock on
and attack.

rec-015304.en:
If the enemy is low
ahead, push the stick to
point down.

rec-01534c.en:
Catch it, lock on, and
attack.

rec-01537c.en:
If they appear to left or
right, roll that way to
turn.

rec-0153e0.en:
For an enemy to the
right, roll right first.

rec-015424.en:
Then pull back to raise
the nose, and you turn
right.

rec-015464.en:
Once they are ahead,
level out again.

rec-01549c.en:
For an enemy on the left,
roll left, raise the nose,
and turn.

rec-0154e4.en:
To turn hard, slow down.
At speed you cannot turn
tight -- bear that in mind.

rec-01555c.en:
To dodge a missile, let it
get close, then break.

rec-0155b0.en:
Time it right and you
should get clear.

rec-015624.en:
Left transform button in
Fighter gives you GERWALK.

rec-01566c.en:
Left transform in GERWALK
gives you Battroid.

rec-0156b0.en:
Right transform in
Battroid gives GERWALK.

rec-0156f0.en:
Right transform in GERWALK
gives Fighter.

rec-015730.en:
Now go to GERWALK, then
on to Battroid.

rec-0157d4.en:
F transform to go back to
Fighter.

rec-015810.en:
Now GERWALK, then back to
Fighter.

rec-015850.en:
Practise until you can
do it freely.

rec-015888.en:
Now go to Battroid. Come
down to the platform and
we move to ground work.

rec-0158e4.en:
What are you doing?
Go to Battroid, quickly!

rec-015920.en:
This is ground work.
Don't climb too high.

rec-015958.en:
Where are you going?
This is ground work.

rec-0159b0.en:
Battroid training from
here. No transforming for
a while.

rec-0159f4.en:
In Battroid, push or pull
the stick to go forward
or back.

rec-015a38.en:
Left and right on the
stick turns you.

rec-015a78.en:
Boost while standing still
to jump; boost while moving
to dash.

rec-015adc.en:
But when the boost gauge
fills, you lose it for a
while. Bear that in mind.

rec-015b38.en:
The gunpod is Battroid's
main weapon.

rec-015b6c.en:
Keep the enemy near screen
centre and it aims itself.

rec-015bb0.en:
When the gunsight sits on
them, press gun to fire.

rec-015bf0.en:
There are target craft on
this field too.

rec-015c5c.en:
Very close in, you can
strike hand to hand.

rec-015c90.en:
Use search mode to deal
with enemies that move
about.

rec-015cd0.en:
It keeps the nearest one
ahead of you.

rec-015cfc.en:
Search mode works only
while the button is held.

rec-015d34.en:
In the air or on the
ground, the quickest way
to find an enemy is
Battroid plus search mode.

rec-015d9c.en:
To dodge in Battroid, use
the sidestep.

rec-015ddc.en:
Sidestep, then put the
stick the other way: you
dodge and come around to
attack at once.

rec-015e44.en:
It is a basic tactic.
Remember it.

rec-015e78.en:
You can dodge missiles by
moving up, down or aside,

rec-015eb8.en:
and in Battroid you can
shoot them down with the
head laser.

rec-015f50.en:
GERWALK training from
here. No transforming.

rec-015f8c.en:
GERWALK handles between
Battroid and Fighter.

rec-015fd0.en:
Turning is as in Battroid,
but forward and back use
the boost and brake.

rec-016024.en:
GERWALK can use gunpod
and missiles both.

rec-016060.en:
Climb and descend let
GERWALK hover.

rec-0160a4.en:
Forward and back are the
same in air.

rec-0160d0.en:
While hovering you can
change the nose angle.

rec-01610c.en:
Handle it well and attack
the targets.

rec-016140.en:
GERWALK is the Valkyrie's
most distinctive mode.

rec-01617c.en:
In the air, going Fighter
to GERWALK lets you brake
hard or stop dead.

rec-0161d8.en:
It also suits quick
changes of heading.

rec-016208.en:
On the ground it moves
faster than Battroid, and
it can put missiles in
from the air.

rec-016264.en:
Learn what GERWALK does
well and use it where it
fits.

rec-0162d0.en:
Attack every target that
appears, ground and air.

rec-016310.en:
Transforming and weapons
are all unlocked.

rec-016344.en:
Use what you learned.
Finish as fast as you can.

rec-016394.en:
Major Focker has a word
for you.

rec-0163c4.en:
All right, rookie. Listen
well. The fights ahead
aren't about just flying
around up there.

rec-016424.en:
You need to fit a changing
fight in an instant. Like
water.

rec-016498.en:
Always shift to the mode
that fits. Clear?

rec-016518.en:
Something wrong? Close in
and put them in the
gunsight.

rec-01655c.en:
Closer, until you have a
short-range lock.

rec-0165d4.en:
Turning, forward and back
are as in Battroid.

rec-01660c.en:
Speed up and close on
the target!

rec-016634.en:
The boost button speeds
you up.

rec-01668c.en:
You cannot use missiles in
Battroid -- remember that!

rec-0166cc.en:
Now the field exercise!
Stay with me, please!

rec-016704.en:
We're doing this the
combat way! Keep up!

rec-01673c.en:
Use the airbrake to slow
down.

rec-016794.en:
Listen to the explanation
and try again.

rec-0167c8.en:
If you lose them, you can
use the search view.

rec-016804.en:
It shows where the near
ones are.

rec-016834.en:
The left transform button
takes you Fighter to
GERWALK to Battroid.

rec-016890.en:
The right button goes the
other way: Battroid to
GERWALK to Fighter.

rec-0168e4.en:
Search in Battroid keeps
an enemy in front of you
at all times.

rec-016934.en:
The climb and descend
buttons make GERWALK
hover.

rec-0169a4.en:
Press search again to
leave search mode.

rec-016a1c.en:
Come down to the platform
for ground work.

rec-016ad0.note: Addressing Captain Global; six-byte slot, so the vocative becomes 'Sir.'

rec-016adc.en:
Very well. Send craft to
support Vermilion 3.

rec-016b18.en:
Roger. Skull and Sepia
Squadrons, support
Vermilion 3.

rec-016bc8.en:
Vermilion 3, the enemy
has broken off. Return.

rec-016c24.en:
Reaction rounds authorised.
Skull Squadron, meet the
enemy to port.

rec-016c7c.en:
Main target: A one three
three, G one six five.

rec-016ce8.en:
Skull Leader to Delta 1.
Mission complete, returning
now!

rec-016dc0.en:
I said no weapons in the
ring. You're off the
mission. Get back to the
Macross.

rec-016e1c.en:
Trouble!
The main gun will not fire!

rec-016e48.en:
Enemy course plotted.
Contact in 90 sec.

rec-016ee0.en:
Gunsight 1 to all craft.
Operation Overrun is live.

rec-016f24.en:
Sara Base reactor is
running away! Critical in
180 seconds!

rec-016f68.en:
That blast kills the
gravity mines and she
lifts!

rec-016fa4.en:
Destroids and Valkyries,
fall back! Draw the enemy
near the base and hurt them
where you can!

rec-01700c.en:
All Valkyries, hold ground
inside the base to draw
them in,

rec-017054.en:
then break at full speed
at ten seconds!

rec-0170bc.en:
All Valkyries, take up
intercept posture!

rec-0170f0.en:
Enemy leader identified!
Drive off the commander
and stop their advance!

rec-017140.en:
Sara Base reactor running
away! Critical in 5 min!

rec-017180.en:
Destroids, fall back now!
Recovering to the Daedalus!

rec-0171c8.en:
Purple Squadron, too far
from the Cat's Eye!

rec-017200.en:
Many enemy units closing.
All craft, launch!

rec-0172b8.en:
Apollo Squadron, don't
let them get a shot!

rec-017548.en:
Welcome to the U.N. Forces Valkyrie
Corps. I'm Lt. Emma Granger, and
I'll be your navigator.
rec-017548.note: Emma names herself here -- the only place in the game she does. Spelling locked: Granger.

rec-0175ec.en:
Major Roy Focker of the Valkyrie
Corps. Over to you, sir.

rec-017630.en:
All right, rookie. You're being
posted to a combat unit.

rec-01767c.en: No promises, but I'll hear you out.

rec-017720.en:
Right. From today you're in the
Prometheus's Valkyrie corps.
Do it properly!

rec-017794.en:
Between us: an ARMD-1 posting means
harder duty than you think.

rec-0177ec.en: You need real nerve for it.

rec-017850.en:
Hm... Well, if you're that set on
it, fine.

rec-017890.en:
No guarantees, but I'll keep your
wishes in mind. Do it properly!

rec-0178e0.en: All right. You're some use now.

rec-017910.en:
Still a rookie, but I'll drill it
into you from here.

rec-017980.en:
You've done well. Your promotion is
confirmed. Second Lieutenant, from
today.

rec-0179d4.en:
You get subordinates too.
In here!

rec-017a00.note: No 'sir' anywhere in lines addressed to the player: the player's gender is unmarked in the source and stays unmarked. See Bible, open canon question 2.

rec-017a64.en:
Green, but they've got the makings.
Look after them.

rec-017ae0.en:
From today Purple Squadron is yours.
Counting on you, Purple Leader.

rec-017b2c.en:
Apollo Squadron is yours now.
Counting on you, Apollo Leader.

rec-017b74.en:
Congratulations, Lieutenant.
I'm rooting for you too.

rec-017bb0.en:
From here the VF-1J is your craft.
I expect even more of you than
before.

rec-017c14.en:
I've followed your record for some
time now!

rec-017c48.en:
Quite a record. Your promotion is
confirmed: First Lieutenant, today.

rec-017cf0.en:
A splendid record. Your promotion is
confirmed. You are a Captain as of
today.

rec-017d44.en: Please go on guarding the Macross.

rec-017d84.en:
Congratulations. Your promotion is
confirmed. You are a Major as of
today.

rec-017dd8.en:
Thanks to you, Major, the Macross has
come this far safely. Please go on
as you have.

rec-017e38.en:
I've heard of you. An able pilot.
A promotion. Congratulations.

rec-017e80.en:
You are a Lieutenant Colonel as of
today. Serve the Macross and the
U.N. Forces well.

rec-017ee0.en:
Congratulations. You're promoted.
Colonel, from today.

rec-017f1c.en:
Having a pilot of your quality is a
great comfort. Keep it up.

rec-017f74.en:
Thank you, Lieutenant. Because of you
the human race survived.

rec-017fc0.en:
This time you served aboard the
Prometheus and achieved this much.

rec-01801c.en: Do try the ARMD-1 posting next time.

rec-018060.en:
This time you served aboard ARMD-1
and achieved this much.

rec-0180b8.en:
Do try the Prometheus posting next
time.

rec-0180fc.en: A new story will be waiting for you.

rec-018134.en:
I look forward to the day you bring a
new assignment home and we meet
again like this.

rec-018194.en:
Lieutenant, thanks to you the human
race has survived again.

rec-0181d8.en:
Thank you truly. But this is not the
end of everything.

rec-01821c.en:
You might look back over these
battles and try another craft.

rec-018264.en:
Other postings and new situations
are waiting for you too.

rec-0182a4.en:
In hope of further progress, I
appoint you Captain.

rec-018308.en:
Congratulations, Captain.
Do your very best!

rec-01834c.en:
Congratulations. A combat unit
at last.

rec-01837c.en:
That's you done with the VF-1D
trainer. Here's a keepsake.

rec-0183bc.en:
A Valkyrie series trading card.
They're all the rage just now.

rec-01840c.en:
Here -- the VF-1D card. Took me ages
to get, but it marks your leaving
the trainer behind.

rec-01846c.en:
Keep it, so you never forget how
you started.

rec-0184a4.en:
Congratulations. Staying alive is
part of the job, and you did.

rec-0184f4.en:
To mark the day, here's a card of
the VF-1A you fly. Take care of it.

rec-018548.en:
Lieutenant! Good work out there.
Heard you collect the cards?

rec-018590.en:
I've got a spare J-type card --
want it? Right, keep at it!

rec-0185e4.en:
Good work on the solo run. How did
the Elint Seeker ride?

rec-018634.en:
I got hold of a very rare Elint
card. Have it, to mark the day.

rec-018680.en:
How fast it goes. The recruit is
flying the same S-type Roy did...

rec-0186d0.en: So Roy's purpose gets carried on.

rec-018704.en:
This S-type card was in Roy's own
collection.

rec-018740.en: Become a pilot as fine as he was.

rec-01877c.en:
To beat me -- fine skill. This is a
Protoculture paper I picked up in
an arcade.
rec-01877c.note: Milia in Micronian form, hunting the ace who beat her. She never says who she is; do not add it.

rec-0187d8.en:
I will come to beat you. Keep it
on you!

rec-018808.en:
Thanks for always cheering me on!
Here -- a VT-1 card my manager got.

rec-01885c.en:
They say the VT-1 seats two. I'd love
to fly over Saturn's rings in one,
with someone lovely.

rec-0188c0.en:
Oh, I have to go -- I've a meeting
about the promo video.

rec-018998.en: Bye then! Work hard, Lt. Colonel!

rec-018aac.en:
Oh, look at this one -- they say
it's a future craft.

rec-018b60.en:
For someone like you,
Lt. Colonel.

rec-018bec.en:
A card of a prototype they think
will see service one day.

rec-018c30.en:
They say it may be controlled by
brainwaves.

rec-018c78.en:
Perhaps the right craft for a pilot
as gifted as you, Lieutenant.

rec-018cd0.en:
Perhaps the right craft for a pilot
as gifted as you, Captain.

rec-018d28.en:
Perhaps the right craft for a pilot
as gifted as you, Major.

rec-018d80.en:
Perhaps the right craft for a pilot
as gifted as you, Lt. Colonel.

rec-018dd8.en:
Perhaps the right craft for a pilot
as gifted as you, Colonel.

rec-018e58.en:
A card of the VF-4, which will
succeed the VF-1 series.

rec-018ea8.en:
When humanity emigrates into space in
earnest, this may be the mainstay of
the escort squadrons.

rec-018f10.en:
Gain more experience still, and
contribute to humanity's future.

rec-018f60.en:
The VF-0, a prototype from the
development days.

rec-018f9c.en: Roy was a test pilot on it, once.

rec-018fd4.en:
No -- more than that. He took this
prototype into real combat.

rec-019018.en:
Even then, humanity was preparing
against the alien threat. For this
very day.

rec-019074.en:
You've done it at last.
Congratulations. I think Roy would
have praised you too.

rec-0190f0.note: Minmay's rank-vocative set, 1783-1787. Lieutenant Colonel abbreviates to 'Lt. Colonel' on the 22-byte slot.

rec-01917c.en:
A fan gave me this. They say it's
really rare!

rec-0191c0.en: It's signed, too. Take care of it!

rec-019210.en:
I happen to have a card in the same
colours as Max's craft. Have it, if
you like.

rec-01926c.en:
Good work. They say a J-type in a
new paint scheme is joining the
corps.

rec-0192bc.en:
I got an early-release card.
Have one.

rec-0192f4.en:
Fond of the blue machines lately?
Here -- the J-type in blue.

rec-019368.en:
To live through this we need song.
Culture.

rec-0193a8.en:
You are the only one who can make
Minmay sing now. Take this and go!

rec-01940c.en:
I hear there is a great pilot near
here, flying the craft on this card.

rec-019464.en:
Tell me if you see them. I have no
telephone. The park, or the arcade.
rec-019464.note: 'they' for the unnamed pilot: the source leaves the addressee's gender unmarked and so must the English.

rec-0194b0.en:
This is the craft Roy flew. He
always bragged it was never once
shot down.

rec-019508.en:
It will look after your craft too.
Keep it safe.

rec-0195d4.en:
Good work on the mission.
A splendid record.

rec-019608.en:
A card of the VT-1 trainer Valkyrie.
Two seats, but it cannot go
Battroid.

rec-019668.en:
Young pilots will go on training in
this one, I expect.

rec-0196e0.en:
The SV-51, built by the Anti-U.N.
in the Unification War.

rec-019724.en:
A very rare card, they say.
Do take care of it.

rec-019fbc.en:
GERWALK turns fast. Go
Battroid and you can search
for the enemy's bearing!

rec-01a018.en:
Fighter to GERWALK is the
L2 button.

rec-01a0d4.en:
Shoot their missiles down
with the gunpod! GERWALK or
Battroid does it best!

rec-01a134.en:
Battroid falls in the air.
Go back to Fighter before
you drop too far.

rec-01a184.en:
GERWALK and Battroid are
too slow to catch anyone.
Go Fighter and chase!

rec-01a1ec.en:
Battroid to GERWALK is the
R2 button.

rec-01a27c.en:
In Battroid, search turns
you to face the enemy!

rec-01a2f4.en:
To shake a missile in
Fighter, run flat out.

rec-01a330.en:
Slam the boost and lose
them!

rec-01a378.en:
If that fails, emergency
evade. Let it get close,
then time it right!

rec-01a3e4.en:
Emergency evade is Fighter
mode only -- mind that!

rec-01a470.en:
Alert!
We are locked on!
From dead ahead!

rec-01a4f8.en:
Alert!
We are locked on!
From astern!

rec-01a9a0.en:
Target has entered normal
missile range!

rec-01a9d8.en:
Target held in normal
missile range!

rec-01ab40.en:
Target held in beam
cannon range!

rec-01ab70.en:
Target has entered beam
cannon range!

rec-01aec4.en:
Craft damage is mounting!
Be careful.

rec-01b6c8.en:
Enemy inbound, enemy
inbound. Scramble all
Valkyries! Repeat,
scramble all Valkyries!

rec-01b72c.en:
Attention. All Valkyrie
combat crews, scramble.
Repeat, all Valkyrie
combat crews, scramble.

rec-01b790.en:
Valkyrie and Ghost units,
all launch. Valkyrie and
Ghost units, all launch.

rec-01ba00.en:
What are you doing?
Follow your orders!

rec-01ba8c.en:
Look around you. You're
the only sloppy one!

rec-01bc24.en:
Keep your quarry away
from the Macross.

rec-01bf4c.en:
Part of their fleet has
turned toward us.

rec-01c0d4.en:
...raise speed, or you
won't make it.

rec-01c2e4.en:
Your charge calls for
help. Go, fast.

rec-01c3e0.en:
Entering the reaction
blast area. Closer to the
target and you take
damage.

rec-01c43c.en:
Entering the reaction kill
zone. Closer to the target
and you die too!

rec-01c490.en:
Use a reaction round at
this range and you take
damage!

rec-01c4d0.en:
A reaction round at this
range kills you too!

rec-01c690.en:
Wrecked! Clear the zone,
go home!

rec-01ca14.en:
Attention. Transformation
begins in three minutes.
Please get to the nearest
shelter as fast as you can.

rec-01caa8.en:
Notice to all citizens.
This ship begins
Transformation in 60
seconds.

rec-01cb08.en:
Enemy craft aboard.
Anyone outdoors, get into
the nearest building!

rec-01ce58.en:
He's locked on!
I can't shake him!

rec-01ceac.en:
Too many of them! Request
support, urgent! Repeat,
urgent!

rec-01cf20.en:
I'm out of weapons!
Support, now!

rec-01cf48.en:
Out of fuel! Can't get
back! Need rescue!

rec-01cfa0.en:
Transform system fault!
I can't change!

rec-01d274.en:
Fighter to GERWALK is the
L1 button.

rec-01d2ac.en:
Fighter to GERWALK is the
R1 button.

rec-01d2e4.en:
Fighter to GERWALK is the
R2 button.

rec-01d31c.en:
Fighter to GERWALK is the
L3 button.

rec-01d354.en:
Fighter to GERWALK is the
