Battroid to GERWALK is the
L1 button.

rec-01d55c.en:
Battroid to GERWALK is the
L2 button.

rec-01d594.en:
Battroid to GERWALK is the
R1 button.

rec-01d5cc.en:
Battroid to GERWALK is the
L3 button.

rec-01d604.en:
Battroid to GERWALK is the
R3 button.

rec-01d910.en:
Not bad at all, Apollo
Leader. But I'm not giving
up ace.

rec-01d99c.en:
Ha! If I go down here
you'll pass my score--
(explosion)
rec-01d99c.note: '(explosion)' and 2245's '(killed)' are performance directions shipped in the data; preserved as parentheticals.

rec-01da98.en:
Apollo 3. I'm hit -- I've
lost control!

rec-01dae0.en:
I'm fine. Not me, not
here-- (killed)

rec-01db2c.en:
You're joking. Hey! Cut
it out...

rec-01dc4c.note: Source distinguishes 'Skull 7' from 'Skull craft number 7'; the second form is kept distinct because both are voiced.

rec-01dd50.en:
Purple 3. I'm hit -- I've
lost control!

rec-01de14.en:
Bad news! They've captured
the Cat's Eye!

rec-01e594.en:
In 1999, an object came without warning
from space: a colossal battleship 1,200
metres long.
rec-01e594.note: Global Report opening. Anchor line for the narrator's voice: measured, past tense, first person, no contractions.

rec-01e5f8.en:
No aliens were aboard, but that ship, far
beyond our technology, proved there was
life out there -- and a war across space.

rec-01e6a4.en:
A U.N. Government rose above national
interest, and repair of the ship began.

rec-01e700.en: Its founding was no easy road.

rec-01e734.en: Fierce local wars were fought worldwide.

rec-01e76c.en: Yet the repair went steadily on.

rec-01e7a4.en:
The long Unification War ended, and
Earth had peace again.

rec-01e7e4.en:
And the fallen ship rose again as a
human one: the battleship Macross.

rec-01e834.en: Ten years had passed since the crash.

rec-01e864.en:
On 7 February 2009 the SDF-1 Macross, of
the U.N. Spacy fleet, was to be
commissioned.

rec-01e8c4.en: In the middle of it, word reached me.

rec-01e8f8.en:
ARMD-1 had detected a gravity anomaly
and a flash of light in lunar orbit.

rec-01e948.en:
It was the same as ten years before,
when the Macross came.

rec-01e990.en:
On her commissioning day, perhaps, the
alien invasion had begun...

rec-01e9d8.en: Uneasy, I slipped out of the ceremony.

rec-01ea0c.en:
What I saw when I reached the Macross
bridge, I could not believe...

rec-01ea58.en:
The defence council had ruled we must not
strike first on meeting aliens. The main
gun, firing itself, overturned that.

rec-01ead8.en:
To my mind, leaving us the Macross was a
trap the aliens had laid -- a booby trap.

rec-01eb38.en:
We had been drawn neatly into a quarrel
between aliens.

rec-01eb7c.en: So the Macross entered the war.

rec-01ebac.en:
The firing had damaged the gravity control
system, but the ship lifted off safely
nonetheless.

rec-01ec10.en:
She made for the rendezvous point to dock
with ARMD-1 and ARMD-2 as originally
planned...

rec-01ec78.en:
To deceive the enemy and escape, the
Macross made a space fold over South
Ataria Island.

rec-01ece0.en:
But the unplanned firing had harmed the
fold system too.

rec-01ed30.en:
She folded and took South Ataria Island
and the carriers at sea with her.

rec-01ed84.en:
And she arrived not behind the moon, as
set, but in the orbit of Pluto.

rec-01ede8.en:
That single fold destroyed the fold
system itself.

rec-01ee2c.en:
We had to return to Earth under normal
drive.

rec-01ee60.en:
We moored the Prometheus and the
Daedalus to her hull,

rec-01eea8.en:
and took aboard the base, the island's
plant, and 56,732 civilians, shelters
and all.

rec-01ef08.en:
With the island's materials they built
a town inside and lived ordinary lives.

rec-01ef5c.en:
Then a new problem surfaced. With the fold
system gone the power connection was cut,
and the main gun could not fire.

rec-01efdc.en:
Transformation restored the severed power
connection.

rec-01f028.en:
The gun could fire, but the citizens paid
heavily for it.

rec-01f078.en:
Later refinements let us evacuate the
citizens first and transform without
wrecking the town.

rec-01f0f0.en:
Meanwhile our engineers found a strange
energy where the fold system had been.

rec-01f148.en:
From it they built a working barrier
system.

rec-01f188.en:
It could not cover the whole ship, but it
could be moved to meet an attack, and so
was named the Pin Point Barrier.

rec-01f208.en:
The Macross was nearing Saturn. To strike
back at last, I chose to hide in the
rings and ambush them.

rec-01f274.en:
Drive the Daedalus, bow in Pin Point
Barrier, into an enemy ship; the
Destroids wreck it from within.

rec-01f2e4.en:
We named it the Daedalus Attack. It drove
them off, and we turned once more for
Earth.

rec-01f344.en:
But the attacks continued, and she was
forced to correct course; her track now
ran close by Mars.

rec-01f3bc.en:
Nearing Mars, she received a telemetry
signal from Sara Base, which was supposed
to be closed.

rec-01f420.en:
We put in at Sara Base, and took on
supplies while we were there.

rec-01f468.en:
At Sara Base we fell into a trap. We ran
the reactor away; the blast killed the
mines and we barely got out.

rec-01f4e0.en:
Eight months had passed since the fold to
Pluto's orbit.

rec-01f528.en:
The civilians aboard adapted to shipboard
life, so far as to open a civilian TV
station.

rec-01f588.en:
To mark its opening, a Miss Macross
contest was to be held.

rec-01f5e0.en:
We had no way of knowing the enemy took
an interest in that broadcast...

rec-01f634.en:
The contest was a great success. Lynn
Minmay, a girl of sixteen, was chosen
Miss Macross.

rec-01f694.en:
The Macross had come close to Earth, only
to be encircled. The war stood still.

rec-01f6f0.en:
Then the enemy jamming, unbroken until
then, suddenly lifted.

rec-01f740.en:
We seized the chance and reported to
U.N. HQ at once. Hours later a signal
came from an unexpected quarter.

rec-01f7b8.en:
They called themselves the Zentradi.
...The enemy we fight to this day.

rec-01f810.en:
They had intercepted our traffic with HQ,
learned our language, and called on us
to surrender...

rec-01f878.en:
To make up for the damaged radar I sent
the Cat's Eye early-warning craft out
on reconnaissance.

rec-01f8e0.en:
Lt. Hayase volunteered for it, and was
lost, along with Vermilion Squadron, who
escorted her.

rec-01f944.en:
At the same time a fold reading from one
enemy ship was detected there. What it
meant, we learned only later.

rec-01f9b8.en:
Lynn Minmay, meanwhile, made her debut as
a singer and rose to stardom in no time.

rec-01fa24.en:
She was an idol born inside the Macross
herself: a meaningful symbol of the
sheltered citizens' culture.

rec-01fa94.en:
And later she would hold the most
important key in this whole war.

rec-01fae4.en:
The deadlock with the Zentradi held, but
behind it things were steadily changing.

rec-01fb40.en:
What Capt. Hayase and four others had to
tell was scarcely believable.

rec-01fb90.en:
The Zentradi had taken and questioned
them; they escaped, and came home by a
miracle.

rec-01fbec.en:
From them we had priceless testimony
about the Zentradi.

rec-01fc30.en:
That their whole society is a military,
and they have no notion of a civilian.

rec-01fc88.en:
That they hold fleets of four to five
million ships.

rec-01fcc8.en:
That men and women together is a deep
taboo, and love unknown to them.

rec-01fd14.en:
That they are not born through pregnancy
and birth, but are believed to multiply
by something like cloning.

rec-01fd8c.en:
That, knowing nothing but war, they are
thought to have been made giant
artificially.

rec-01fdec.en:
That they have Micloneation: a means of
shrinking a giant to human size.

rec-01fe64.en:
of being Protoculture, their makers, with
power enough to shake their whole order --

rec-01fef0.en:
It does explain their attacks: crushing
strength, and yet something hesitant in
them.

rec-01ff50.en:
Earth was close. I resolved to carry this
intelligence to U.N. HQ myself.

rec-01ffa8.en:
At the same hour as Capt. Hayase's
return, three Zentradi Micronian spies
slipped aboard the Macross unseen.

rec-020020.en:
Unknown to us, matters were growing more
tangled still.

rec-020064.en:
On 29 November 2009 we came home to
Earth at last.

rec-0200a4.en:
While the decks rang with celebration,
Capt. Hayase and I went to U.N. HQ to
report what we knew of the enemy.

rec-020124.en:
By then the three Zentradi spies aboard
the Macross had been shaken by how human
beings live.

rec-020190.en:
Men and women close; people who were
not soldiers; amusement unconnected to
war. All of it astonished them.

rec-020204.en:
What drew them most was Lynn Minmay, and
her singing voice.

rec-0202c8.en:
At U.N. HQ in Alaska, our report was
debated and a response weighed.

rec-020318.en:
The conclusion they reached was harsh
beyond measure.

rec-02035c.en:
Contact and a ceasefire were refused. The
56,000 civilians could not disembark: the
war was to be kept secret.

rec-0203d4.en:
Further, the Macross was to keep them
aboard and play for time by drawing the
enemy's eye.

rec-020434.en:
How was I to tell so cruel a decision to
people still rejoicing at coming home?
I agonised.

rec-02049c.en:
On 5 December 2009 Major Roy Focker, U.N.
Forces pilot, was wounded in action
against the Zentradi, and died.

rec-020514.en: The wound was taken in combat.

rec-02053c.en:
By its size, he must have known he was
dying when he climbed out of the cockpit.

rec-02059c.note: 'his lover's room' -- the source never names Claudia here, and neither does the English.

rec-020610.en:
In later years an award was founded in
Roy Focker's name, and fine pilots have
been honoured with it since.

rec-020684.en:
What we have lost is too great. But until
the day the fighting ends, we have to
keep going.

rec-0206f0.en:
That fight, we later learned, had been
started by one Zentradi officer who
wanted to face the Macross's best pilot.

rec-02076c.en:
This too would weigh heavily on all that
followed.

rec-0207b0.en:
Against HQ's ruling, and to win at least
the civilians' right to leave the ship,
I flew the Macross over the cities.

rec-020834.en:
I could not overturn the decision, but I
wanted Earth's eyes on us, and a thread
to pull the thing open by.

rec-0208a8.en:
Happily, the North American Ontario
Autonomous Region, which had listened in
on our exchanges, offered to take them.

rec-020928.en: The Macross turned for Ontario at once...

rec-020964.en:
The Omnidirectional Barrier ran away and
blew, erasing the enemy ships and the
city below, fifty kilometres around.

rec-0209e0.en:
Only the Macross, at the centre, was
spared. No word for that but irony.

rec-020a34.en:
Ontario withdrew its offer, as was only
to be expected, and with it every means
of putting the civilians ashore.

rec-020aac.en:
Resupplied, the Macross was ordered by HQ
to guard the civilians aboard and to
leave Earth within 24 hours.

rec-020b2c.en:
I told everyone aboard over the ship's
channel, and took her out.

rec-020b88.en:
Happily the civilians took it calmly,
and there was no great disorder.

rec-020be8.en:
If anything they threw themselves in
harder, and got a film made wholly
aboard, 'Shao Pai Long', released.
rec-020be8.note: 'Shao Pai Long': the in-fiction film's title, romanised rather than translated.

rec-020c58.en:
At the same time the three Zentradi spies
long aboard slipped out of the Macross
and returned to their army.

rec-020cd4.en:
Their report on human culture must have
carried more astonishment than ours did
when we first learned about them.

rec-020d4c.en:
On the strength of the fragments of
culture they had smuggled out, they
preached its wonders to their soldiers.

rec-020dc4.en:
There too, Lynn Minmay posters and dolls
that played her voice greatly stirred
the soldiers.

rec-020e28.en:
Perhaps they only wanted to boast of
having touched culture.

rec-020e74.en:
But sympathisers multiplied, and a strong
envy of Earth's culture spread as a wave
through Britai's Adoclas fleet.

rec-020ef4.en:
Meanwhile, as if changing places with
them, another Micronian spy got aboard
the Macross.

rec-020f58.en:
That spy was the finest ace pilot in the
Zentradi forces -- the one who had once
started a battle only to fight Max.

rec-020fd8.en:
First Air Officer Milia Fallyna, of
Laplamiz's fleet in the Golg Grand Fleet.
A Zentradi girl.

rec-02103c.en: So every factor was now on the stage.

rec-021070.en:
History began to move toward an end
nobody had imagined.

rec-0210cc.en:
Led by the three spies who had been
aboard, they had been touched by Earth's
culture and longed for a life besides war.

rec-02114c.en:
They shrank their giant bodies to human
size on purpose, and came to us ready to
die for it.

rec-0211b0.en:
Medical tests showed them our own
species, down to the structure of
their genes.

rec-021210.en:
Hard as it is to believe, we are what
they call the Protoculture.

rec-02125c.en: I chose to take the defectors in.

rec-021288.en:
If, as Capt. Hayase argued, the Zentradi
could be taught creative work besides
war -- taught culture --

rec-0212f8.en:
then perhaps an end could be brought to
this hopeless war. So I reasoned.

rec-021358.en:
But I could not think U.N. HQ would
accept the idea easily.

rec-0213a8.en:
Capt. Hayase volunteered to persuade
them herself because she knew that
very well.

rec-021404.en:
She left for Earth in secret to call at
HQ and urge them to take the defectors
in and talk peace with them.

rec-02147c.en:
HQ weighed the peace proposal while also
preparing to bargain with the power of
its newest weapon, the Grand Cannon.

rec-0214fc.en:
HQ's view was that no peaceful settlement
with aliens was possible at all.

rec-021560.en:
Meanwhile, amid the hardship, something
delightful and dramatic happened aboard.

rec-0215b8.en:
The marriage of Lt. Maximilian Jenius,
the young ace of the Valkyrie corps.

rec-021610.en:
His bride, of all people, was the
Zentradi girl Milia Fallyna.

rec-02165c.en:
She had slipped aboard to avenge her
defeat by him in battle, and instead,
they say, fell in love with him.

rec-0216d8.en:
The first interstellar marriage in
human history.

rec-021714.en:
Surely it was the symbol of a road to
mutual understanding and peace with the
Zentradi.

rec-021780.en:
I backed the marriage wholly, and
declared the defectors formally received.

rec-0217d4.en:
The shipboard station broadcast the whole
historic wedding, and it shook the
Zentradi badly.

rec-02183c.en:
Their astonishment must have been many
times ours.

rec-02187c.en:
During the reception, the distant enemy
fleet began to move as one.

rec-0218d0.en:
Facing a thousand ships, I thought our
luck had run out. Then a miracle.

rec-02192c.en:
Their ships slowed, and the attack was
called off.

rec-021968.en: Then an envoy came for a truce.

rec-021994.en:
The envoy was Exsedol Folmo, Zem class
one recording officer.

rec-0219dc.en: He told us how the truce came about.

rec-021a0c.en:
The Zentradi had suspected humans of
being the Protoculture.

rec-021a58.en:
They mistook the powers in the film
'Shao Pai Long', and the barrier's
runaway, for Protoculture power.

rec-021ac8.en:
But the true Protoculture power, which
we had never noticed, truly was aboard
the Macross.

rec-021b58.en:
The three Micronian spies behind the
Protoculture shock -- Konda, Loli and
Warera -- testified thus.

rec-021bc8.en:
'It is real. We were moved by the
power of song.'
rec-021bc8.note: The spies' testimony, in the source's own quotation marks. Kept short: it is a quotation inside narration.

rec-021c2c.en:
Those who met the Protoculture of old
woke to song, to culture, lost the will
to fight, and perished.

rec-021c9c.en:
To us Zentradi, battle is life; our
history has been piled up by fighting.

rec-021cf8.en:
But now my soldiers have touched culture
and have begun refusing to fight.

rec-021d48.en:
Supreme Commander Bodolza, so as not to
repeat the old error, left all contact
to us alone.

rec-021dac.en:
But if he learns we have touched it he
will attack in force, to erase Earth's
culture and us with it.

rec-021e18.en:
And as if to bear him out, word came by
way of a Zentradi ship that the Grand
Fleet was bound for this system.

rec-021e94.en:
With 4,791,122 ships about to fall on
us,

rec-021ec4.en: Exsedol said there was still a chance...

rec-021efc.en:
Of all the events, the one that drew the
greatest crowds was the Miss Macross
contest.

rec-021f5c.en:
The crown went to Miss Lynn Minmay, who
had come from Japan for the contest.

rec-021fc0.en:
She -- no, most of those gathered --
would follow a strange fate with the
Macross.

rec-022024.en:
At that hour, far above the happy noise,
the sign could be seen.

rec-022070.en:
A gravity anomaly, announcing her long
hard voyage and a war for human
survival...

rec-0220cc.en:
To escape the attack and protect the
civilians aboard, we made a superspace
jump: a fold.

rec-022130.en:
Behind the moon: regroup there, and
wait for U.N. support.

rec-022178.en:
But when the fold was done, the Macross
fixed her position near the orbit of
Pluto, far out in the system.

rec-0221e8.en:
That was my error of judgement. I used
alien technology without understanding
it.
rec-0221e8.note: Global admitting the fold was his mistake, in plain words. Do not soften.

rec-022248.en:
That one fold destroyed the fold system
itself.

rec-022298.en:
And so the Macross set out on a long
voyage: home to Earth under normal drive.

rec-022304.en:
The fifty thousand civilians aboard began
making living space inside the ship.

rec-022360.en:
Happily she carried much material, loaded
for trials toward interstellar
emigration.

rec-0223c0.en:
People struggled to win back a social
life, and in time a town grew inside
her.

rec-02241c.en:
The loss of the fold system, meanwhile,
had badly hurt her ability to fight.

rec-022470.en:
Her reactor, the source of all power,
was connected to the main gun through
the fold system.

rec-0224d4.en:
With the system gone the connection was
cut, and the main gun, our greatest
weapon, could not be used.

rec-022548.en:
The ship's engineers proposed a way out
of it.

rec-02258c.en:
Use the ship's block construction to
transform her,

rec-0225d0.en: and so connect reactor and main gun.

rec-022608.en:
It was so wild, and its effect inside so
unforeseeable, that it hardly seemed
real.

rec-022664.en: We cannot reach the U.N. Forces.

rec-02268c.en:
I take it the enemy are jamming us
somehow -- though Earth may be keeping
radio silence to guard information.

rec-02270c.en:
If the latter, Earth must know how the
Macross stands, and some help may not be
far off.

rec-022778.en:
I would rather stay clear of them
till then.

rec-0227d0.en:
Transformation did great damage to the
town inside her, but the main gun's power
was terrible: one shot destroyed a ship.

rec-022850.en:
But in gun configuration she could not
get the thrust she needed, and her speed
fell away sharply.

rec-0228c4.en:
To make for Earth as fast as we could,
she had to return to her old shape, and
transform again at every attack.

rec-02293c.en:
With the citizens' help the town was
rebuilt to suit it.

rec-022980.en:
Alarms and shelters were arranged, and
drills were held.

rec-0229cc.en:
The people of the Macross faced wartime
squarely, and adapted well.

rec-022a18.en:
The symbol of that, one might say, was
Miss Lynn Minmay, who won the Miss
Macross contest and debuted as an idol.

rec-022a98.en: An idol born among the ship's refugees.

rec-022acc.en:
As a symbol of the citizens' culture she
won huge support and rose to stardom
fast.

rec-022b28.en: She went as far as a concert aboard.

rec-022b5c.en:
Dodging several enemy attacks as best we
could, the Macross reached Saturn's
orbit.

rec-022bb8.en:
I chose to regroup at Titan, Saturn's
moon.

rec-022bf4.en:
There, if it came to it, we could hide in
Titan's gas and still use the main gun --
or so I thought.

rec-022c64.en:
At Titan the enemy got inside the ship,
but we barely cleared them out.

rec-022cc0.en:
We did not know that their soldiers had
learned something aboard and carried it
home.

rec-022d20.en:
That knowledge stirred them greatly, and
an incident came of it.

rec-022d70.en:
It began when Lt. Hikaru Ichijo of the
Valkyrie corps took a VT-1 trainer
without leave.

rec-022de0.en:
Miss Lynn Minmay, it emerged, was in the
back seat.

rec-022e28.en:
Her manager, Lynn Kaifun, went after
them with the flight controller, Capt.
Misa Hayase, in the launch Rabbit.

rec-022ea4.en: An enemy force attacked them both.

rec-022ed4.en:
It touched on a U.N. scandal, and Kaifun
will have pressed her, fearing one about
Minmay.

rec-022f48.en:
Her great trust in Major Focker may have
swayed her judgement too.

rec-022f98.en:
Meaning to settle it quietly, Capt.
Hayase called Major Roy Focker privately
instead of asking the whole force.

rec-023010.en:
And all five, the Major included, were
lost.

rec-023064.en:
Set against the dead each battle piles
up, three soldiers and two civilians may
seem a small thing.

rec-0230d4.en:
Even with the U.N.'s finest ace and an
idol at the height of her fame among
them.

rec-023130.en:
But we would learn later that this
incident carried grave meaning.

rec-023188.en:
On alert and still in gun configuration,
the Macross crossed Saturn's space.

rec-0231dc.en:
The rings spoiled our wide-area radar,
but the enemy must have been groping
too.

rec-023240.en:
I chose to hide in the rings' shadow and
let them pass.

rec-023284.en:
Leaving Saturn, we returned to the
fortress form and pressed on toward
Earth at speed.

rec-0232e8.en:
Nearly seven months into a voyage begun
unprepared, shortages began to show.

rec-023344.en:
We chose to call at Sara Base, the U.N.
post built long ago on Mars and now
abandoned, and look for supplies.

rec-0233bc.en:
On the corrected course, a volume
looking like a great battle site came
into view.

rec-023418.en:
Among the wreckage we found a large ship
little damaged.

rec-023464.en:
The ship plainly belonged to the aliens
we fight, but it had not been destroyed
in any battle with us.

rec-0234d8.en:
We judged that a war between aliens was
going on in this system.

rec-023520.en:
In any case, for us, who had nothing but
wrecked battle pods to learn from, this
was a splendid chance.

rec-023590.en: I sent a survey party inside her.

rec-0235c4.en:
We failed to draw anything from her
computer, but the survey did yield
several interesting things.

rec-023640.en:
Most startling: the ship herself seems
to have been built tens of thousands of
years ago.

rec-0236a4.en:
Have they been fighting for tens of
thousands of years?

rec-0236e4.en:
But what interested me more was the
impression the survey party took away.

rec-02373c.en:
'I feel they are missing something that
matters most to a human being,' one of
them said.

rec-0237a0.en:
There was damage everywhere, old and
new, and no sign at all that any of it
had ever been repaired.

rec-02380c.en:
They use a broken thing broken, and
throw it away when it fails. Soldiers
and all...

rec-023868.en:
They are not human, so perhaps it is
natural that we cannot understand.

rec-0238dc.en:
The war god's planet. Rome's Mars, they
say, had a farming aspect too.

rec-02392c.en:
May he lead us to victory with plenty
of supplies.

rec-023968.en:
Resupplied at Mars, we drew near Earth
and received a fold transmission.

rec-0239c4.en:
It broke off so quickly that we could
not read it, but the source was Earth.

rec-023a20.en:
I ordered a reply asking them to answer.
Nothing came.

rec-023a64.en: Days later we set foot on Earth.

rec-023a90.en:
And we learned why no word had reached us
from Earth since the fold.

rec-023af0.en:
U.N. Headquarters in Alaska lay swallowed
in lava.

rec-023b30.en:
Every major city was destroyed. Nowhere
any sign of a living soul.

rec-023b78.en:
On a thread of hope I turned her toward
the source of that last fold
transmission.

rec-023bd8.en:
A vast island of ruins, afloat on
the sea.

rec-023c0c.en:
And there to meet the Macross were two
of the five lost at Saturn: Capt. Misa
Hayase and Lt. Hikaru Ichijo.

rec-023cb4.en:
All five had been carried off at Saturn
and held prisoner by the Zentradi we
fight.

rec-023d18.en:
After they were questioned, another
alien force attacked.

rec-023d58.en:
In that confusion Major Focker, Capt.
Hayase and Lt. Ichijo made their escape.
The Major fell.

rec-023dc0.en:
Hayase and Ichijo tried to rescue Lynn
Minmay and Lynn Kaifun, also held
prisoner.

rec-023e24.en:
The ship folded, the attempt failed, and
they were thrown out of fold space onto
Earth.

rec-023e88.en:
In a month of searching, they say, they
found no survivor on Earth.

rec-023ed8.en:
All of them were probably killed in the
first attack. We came all this way to an
Earth with nobody waiting.

rec-023f50.en:
They found these ruins by chance, left
by a prehistoric civilisation: the
Protoculture.

rec-023fb0.en:
Trying a fold transmission from the ruins,
they woke the caretaker computer, which
told a story back to our origins.

rec-02402c.en:
Their genetics advanced until men could
breed from men, and women from women.

rec-02408c.en:
Then they split into all-male Zentradi
and all-female Meltrandi, and went to
war.

rec-0240e8.en:
The giants who know nothing but fighting
were made then.

rec-024134.en:
Only when the war grew fierce enough to
destroy their own civilisation did they
see the mistake.

rec-0241a0.en:
They fled to Earth, seeking a place where
men and women could live together.

rec-0241f4.en:
They altered the genes of the natives
they found and made our ancestors.

rec-024244.en:
Twenty thousand years ago the war reached
this system. They hid the city in the sea
and left, and never returned.

rec-0242c0.en:
It read the Zentradi attack on
commissioning day as the Protoculture's
return, and raised part of the city.

rec-024338.en:
Then, for those who reached it, it spent
its last energy to raise the whole
island.

rec-024394.en:
It is hard to believe at first hearing,
but with the Protoculture's ruins before
us, we had to accept it all.

rec-024418.en:
At 1100 on 11 September 2009 the SDF-1
Macross of the U.N. Spacy concluded peace
with the Zentradi 425th Bodol Grand Fleet.

rec-0244a4.en:
The Macross had taken a mortal blow from
the Meltrandi raid when the Zentradi Bodol
flagship appeared and drove them off.

rec-024524.en:
They sent three envoys shrunk to human
size -- Micronians, as they call them --
and asked for a ceasefire.

rec-02459c.en:
And Lynn Minmay and Lynn Kaifun, held
prisoner by the Zentradi, came home
safely.

rec-024600.en:
The Zentradi had wondered why soldiers
who picked up the Macross's broadcasts
could no longer fight.

rec-024670.en:
Knowing no culture, unheard music took
them, and their will to fight.

rec-0246c8.en: They feared it as Protoculture power.

rec-024704.en:
Long ago, Commander Bodolza had obtained
a memory plate: a 'fragment of culture'.

rec-024768.en:
He believed the melody stored in it,
given words and finished as a song, would
be a weapon against the Meltrandi.

rec-0247e8.en:
The words were on the plate Capt. Hayase
picked up in the ruins.

rec-024834.en:
But Lynn Minmay went missing, and the
Meltrandi attack began at once.

rec-024890.en:
Learning she was gone, Bodolza tore up
the peace and attacked both the Macross
and the Meltrandi.

rec-024908.en:
To people who think of nothing but war,
a Macross worthless as a weapon was
merely an eyesore.

rec-024970.en: I declared Condition One in all ships.

rec-02499c.en:
The brief peace was over, and the
Macross had to begin fighting to survive
once more.

rec-0249fc.en:
In a hopeless situation, Lynn Minmay
alone held the key to a faint hope...

rec-024a4c.en:
'Milia the Ace', First Air Officer of
Laplamiz's fleet, was famed through the
Zentradi for her genius.

rec-024ab8.en:
But Kamjin Kravshera told her there was
one great pilot aboard the Macross too.

rec-024b20.en:
Home at Earth, the Macross resupplied
over the Pacific.

rec-024b64.en:
Meaning to meet that pilot, she led her
unit in a raid on the Macross.

rec-024bb4.en:
And a meeting was beginning that would
change our fate greatly, later on.

rec-024c30.en:
The defectors showed that living
together might be possible.

rec-024c78.en:
Finding a faint hope in it, Misa resolved
to go down to Earth and persuade
U.N. HQ.

rec-024cd8.en:
Telling Lt. Ichijo she might never come
back to the Macross, she boarded a
shuttle for Earth.

rec-024d70.en:
Lt. Jenius of the escort called for help,
but help would take twenty minutes at
full speed to reach her.

rec-024de4.en:
Captain Global put the 'Booby Duck', a
Valkyrie with a fast pack, into action,
and named Lt. Ichijo to fly it.

rec-024e5c.en:
At the request of MBS, the shipboard TV
station, the military agreed to help make
a promotional film for Lynn Minmay.

rec-024edc.en:
They wanted a scene of her singing in a
Valkyrie cockpit, flying over Saturn's
rings.

rec-024f3c.en:
We agonised over who should fly it. In
the end one name was left.

rec-024f8c.en:
The five taken prisoner in Saturn's
rings: Major Roy Focker, Lt. Hayase,
Lt. Ichijo, Lynn Minmay, Lynn Kaifun.

rec-025000.en:
In the confusion of a battle aboard the
ship, they tried to escape.

rec-02504c.en:
But Major Roy Focker fell aboard that
ship, and Lynn Minmay and Lynn Kaifun
were carried off in it.

rec-0250cc.en:
Lt. Hayase and Lt. Ichijo did get clear,
but were caught in the ship's fold and
came, by chance, to a ruined Earth.

rec-02514c.en:
Seeking survivors, the two flew a VT-1
Ostrich across the world.

rec-025194.en:
But a month passed emptily without one
survivor found.

rec-0251f0.en:
The Macross reached the island it took
for the source of that fold
transmission.

rec-025250.en:
Morq Laplamiz, the Meltrandi commander,
moved to seize the ruins, seeking the
'fragment of culture' that held the key.

rec-0252d0.en:
Milia the ace, captain of a medium
gunship of Laplamiz's fleet, boarded a
Queadluun-Rau and led her unit down.

rec-025350.en:
Maximilian Jenius, the genius pilot who
followed Roy Focker as leader, went up
with Hikaru and Kakizaki.

rec-0253d0.en:
In that crisis the one hope was Lynn
Minmay's singing voice.

rec-02541c.en:
Hikaru found Minmay, who had run off
hurt, and talked her round.

rec-02546c.en:
Minmay took the Protoculture words Misa
had found, and stood on the stage.

rec-0254c4.en:
That they suspect and fear us of being
Protoculture -- their makers, with power
enough to shake their whole order...

rec-02555c.en:
That men and women together is a deep
taboo, love unknown, and that they
seem to multiply by cloning.

rec-0255cc.en:
To carry this intelligence to HQ myself,
I resolved to force the cordon.

rec-025624.en:
In November 2009 we found a gap in the
cordon, and came home to Earth at last.

rec-025688.en:
At the same time three Zentradi Micronian
spies got aboard the Macross, and were
shaken by how human beings live.

rec-025700.en:
The conclusion they reached was harsh
beyond measure.

rec-025740.en:
In 1999, an object came without warning
from space: a colossal battleship 1,200
metres long.

rec-0257a4.en:
And the fallen ship rose again as a
human one: the battleship Macross.

rec-0257f0.en:
I would rather have kept clear of them
till then. Of course we did not...

rec-025840.en:
As a symbol of the citizens' culture she
won huge support, rose to stardom fast,
and went as far as a concert aboard.

rec-0258c0.en:
The two searched Earth for a month and
found no survivor.

rec-025914.en:
Twenty thousand years ago, when the war
reached this system, they hid the city in
the sea and left. They never came back.

rec-02599c.en:
The firing had damaged the gravity
control system, but the ship lifted off
safely, and

rec-025a00.en:
Transformation restored the severed
power connection, and

rec-025a4c.en:
Nearing Saturn, and to strike back at
last, I chose to hide in the rings and
ambush them.

rec-025ab0.en:
She folded and took South Ataria and
the carriers at sea with her.

rec-025afc.en:
The fold system vanished with the fold,
and she had to make for Earth under
normal drive.

rec-025b60.en:
We moored the Prometheus and the Daedalus
to her, and took aboard fifty thousand
civilians, shelters and all.

rec-025be4.en:
Then a new problem surfaced. With the fold
system gone the power connection was cut,
and the main gun could not fire.

rec-025c64.en:
Transformation put the power back and the
main gun could fire, but it did terrible
damage to everyone in the town.

rec-025cf0.en:
After that they worked things out, so
everyone could take shelter and the town
wasn't wrecked when we transformed.

rec-025d6c.en:
The engineers found a strange energy in
the space where the fold system had been,
and made a barrier system out of it.

rec-025df0.en:
It can't cover the whole ship, but it can
be moved to meet an attack, so they named
it the Pin Point Barrier.

rec-025e78.en:
The Macross is coming up on Saturn. To
strike first, the Captain planned an
ambush from inside the rings.

rec-025ef0.en:
Lt. Hayase named it the Daedalus Attack.
It drove them off somehow, and we set
course for Earth again.

rec-025f60.en:
But the attacks kept coming, we had to
correct course, and we ended up passing
close by Mars.

rec-025fcc.en:
As we neared Mars a telemetry signal came
from Sara Base, which was supposed to be
closed, so

rec-026030.en:
the Macross put in there to look into it
and take on supplies.

rec-026088.en:
Eight months have passed since we left
Earth in the Macross.

rec-0260cc.en:
Everyone in town has got used to life
aboard, and I'm enjoying high school.
Now we're to have TV on the ship!

rec-02614c.en:
To mark the opening there's a Miss Macross
contest, and the head of the town
association entered me without asking!

rec-0261d8.en:
But to think the alien enemy were
watching it too! That gives me a bit of
a shock.

rec-026234.en:
The contest was a great success, and
Minmay was chosen Miss Macross.
rec-026234.note: The diary track says 'I entered too' at 2616 but names Minmay in the third person here. The source's own person is kept in both. See Q-13.

rec-026284.en:
The Macross has come close to Earth, but
is encircled, and the war stands still.

rec-0262e0.en:
We got word to U.N. Headquarters while
the jamming lifted, but the aliens picked
it up and cracked our language in no time.

rec-02636c.en:
Then they called themselves Zentradi and
sent us a demand to surrender...

rec-0263bc.en:
The boss, me and Max were escorting
Lt. Hayase's Cat's Eye, and the aliens
carried the lot of us off with her.

rec-026430.en:
What we saw was a world of giants with
crushing strength who think of nothing
but war.

rec-026490.en:
And Minmay's singing debut coming up,
too, now she's Miss Macross.

rec-0264e8.en:
Boss, let's get out of here!
This place...

rec-02651c.en:
Major Roy Focker, U.N. Forces pilot, was
wounded in action against the Zentradi,
and died.

rec-02657c.en:
He came to my room as always, for the
pineapple salad he was promised, and
fell there at his guitar.

rec-0265f0.en:
What we have lost is too great. But
until the day the fighting ends, we
have to keep going.

rec-026660.en:
Against HQ's decision, Captain Global
flew the Macross over the cities.

rec-0266c0.en:
He could not overturn the decision, but
he thought he might catch Earth's eye and
find a thread to pull the thing open by.

rec-026740.en:
Happily the North American Ontario
Autonomous Region, which listened in on
the exchanges, offered to take them.

rec-0267b8.en:
The Macross's Omnidirectional Barrier ran
away and blew, erasing not only the ships
around but a Micronian city.

rec-026830.en:
Only the Macross came through. Irony,
nothing else.

rec-026878.en:
The Macross was driven off the
Micronians' home world.

rec-0268bc.en:
We three got out safely and reported to
the Zentradi forces about the Micronians.

rec-026920.en:
Our report set Lord Britai and Officer
Exsedol holding their heads. But the days
after we came back tasted of nothing.

rec-0269a8.en:
Showing off the fragments of culture we
had smuggled back, boasting to the lads,
we slowly saw what a fine place that was.

rec-026a34.en: The lads who heard us all envy us...

rec-026a6c.en: We quietly made a big decision...

rec-026a98.en:
Soldiers egged on by the Micronian spies
have defected to the Macross. For a
Zentradi soldier, it is unthinkable.

rec-026b10.en:
Supreme Commander Bodolza foretold that
dealing with people who have culture
brings ill. So it has proved.

rec-026b80.en:
Then something less believable still.
Milia boarded the Macross to avenge her
defeat -- and is to mate with a Micronian.

rec-026c10.en:
The Micronians cried it up as the marriage
of the century and broadcast it. Bodolza
took it gravely and ordered them erased.

rec-026c98.en:
We went out in full force at last to destroy
the Macross utterly, and then had to take a
truce: refusal to fight and riot had spread.
rec-026c98.note: Britai's track. Zentradi register: no contractions anywhere in this narrator.

rec-026d30.en:
I had sent Recording Officer Exsedol,
Micloned, as truce envoy. Then word came
that the Grand Fleet was bound here.

rec-026db0.en:
The Supreme Commander has judged
humans to be Protoculture.

rec-026df4.en: The Macross is no longer our enemy.

rec-026e28.en:
For we too, judged tainted by
Protoculture, are fated to be erased by
the Grand Fleet...

rec-026e88.en:
Transformation did great damage to the
town inside, but the main gun's power
destroyed the enemy ship.

rec-026efc.en:
The town was rebuilt to suit
transformation, and people are slowly
getting used to life on the Macross.

rec-026f6c.en:
Five months since we left Earth, and I,
who made my debut inside the Macross, am
to hold my first concert.

rec-026fe0.en:
And all five, including Major Roy Focker,
who hurried to the scene, were lost.

rec-027044.en:
We would learn later that this was more
than five people missing: it carried
grave meaning.

rec-0270b0.en:
We chose to hide in the rings' shadow
and let them pass.

rec-0270f8.en: The Macross finally got back to Earth.

rec-027124.en:
But Earth was already wrecked.
Not one soul left alive.

rec-027170.en:
We made for the source of that one fold
signal, and there we ran into Capt.
Hayase and Lt. Ichijo.

rec-0271dc.en:
Taken at Saturn, the two got out of an
enemy ship mid-fold and jumped to Earth,
seemingly.

rec-02723c.en:
This island is a huge ship the aliens
left, and they made humans and the
giants we fight.

rec-0272a8.en:
It got complicated and I didn't follow
much, but Ichijo is back at last, and
Skull Squadron lives again.

rec-027320.en:
Zentradi, Meltrandi, whatever they are --
just leave it to Kakizaki.

rec-02739c.en:
The Zentradi 425th Bodol Grand Fleet
concluded peace with the U.N. Spacy's
SDF-1 Macross.

rec-027400.en:
We had Minmay sing the miizon on the
fragment of culture, and the Meltrandi
withdrew handsomely.
rec-027400.note: miizon / kaashii: the Protoculture words for the melody and the words of the song. Transliterated, unglossed, exactly as the source leaves them.

rec-02746c.en:
Add what Minmay calls the kaashii and
make it a song, and it will beyond doubt
be an absolute weapon against them.

rec-0274e4.en:
The Supreme Commander ordered the peace
to make the Micronians write the kaashii.

rec-02753c.en:
But the Meltrandi fleet has appeared, and
Minmay, who matters most, seems to have
gone missing.

rec-0275a4.en:
Leaving prisoners loose was the first
mistake. Micronian slackness leaves me
speechless.

rec-02760c.en:
Without the kaashii the Meltran will
not be brought down.

rec-02764c.en:
The Supreme Commander has decided to
erase Meltrandi and Micronians alike.

rec-0276a4.en:
Everyone in town has got used to life
aboard, and ordinary civilian life goes
on. Now we're even to have TV aboard.

rec-027728.en:
To mark the opening there's a Miss
Macross contest, and the whole ship is
in a bit of a carnival.

rec-027790.en:
But to think the alien enemy were
watching it too... I wonder how it
looked to their eyes.

rec-0277fc.en:
Five months since we left Earth, and the
Macross has finally reached Saturn's
orbit.

Drive off the enemy

Destroy the ship's guns

Arm reaction rounds;
